jobs.description:
Become a part of our caring community

We are seeking a Clinical Pharmacist to join our primary care organization. You will play a critical role in improving patient outcomes through effective medication management, patient education, and collaboration with our healthcare team. In this role, you will support the full physician panel, regardless of health plan coverage and may involve multiple clinic locations.

In this remote position, you will report to the Associate Director Integrated Clinic Pharmacist and will integrate the pharmacist as a member of the care team within the physician practice.

Your daily responsibilities will include:

  • Use evidence-based medicine and clinical judgment to evaluate the suitability of pharmacotherapy for high-risk patients with chronic conditions, including diabetes, hypertension, heart failure and COPD.

  • Execute clinical protocols as allowed per organization and state regulatory agencies.

  • Optimization of drug coverage benefits for appropriate care and reduced costs (preferred formulary products, lower cost alternatives and home delivery pharmacy).

  • Collaborate with physicians, nurses, and other healthcare professionals to optimize patient care.

  • Participate in high-risk rounds with a multi-disciplinary team to discuss patient progress and adjust treatment plans.

  • Excellent patient counseling skills and the ability to communicate complex medical information to patients and healthcare providers.

  • Disease state education for patients on appropriate use of medications and self-management.

  • Engage in quality improvement initiatives aimed at enhancing medication safety and efficacy.

  • Post-discharge medication reconciliation for high-risk transition of care patients.

  • Document all activity within clinic EMR and other required pharmacy or clinical management systems.

  • Support CMS Stars and HEDIS quality measures for successful clinic performance.

  • Maintain accurate documentation of clinical interventions and patient care activities.

  • Conduct in-service education and training sessions for healthcare staff and develop and share educational materials related to pharmacotherapy.

  • Stay current with advancements in pharmacotherapy and clinical guidelines.

  • Provide consultation to healthcare providers on complex medication management issues.

  • Respond to additional requests from the Primary Care Organization, providing support within the pharmacist's defined scope of practice to advance organizational goals.

  • Address and implement targeted initiatives or priorities as directed by the National Director or Associate Directors of Pharmacy, according to best practices and regulatory standards.


Use your skills to make an impact

Minimum Requirements

  • Active and unrestricted pharmacist license in the state of Florida

  • Willingness to become licensed in additional states for market support

  • Pharm.D. or other advanced pharmacy degree

  • Minimum five (5) years of experience as a practicing pharmacist

  • Experience working in a team environment and supporting common goals

  • Proficiency using with MS Office programs such as Word, Excel and Power Point, Teams, Outlook, and troubleshoot and resolve basic technical needs within a remote environment.

Preferred Requirements

  • Clinical residency in ambulatory care or similar discipline

  • Board certification in geriatric pharmacy

  • Experience working in an ambulatory care/primary practice setting

  • Familiarity with electronic medical record (EMR) systems

  • Experience in managing drug therapy for patients with chronic conditions

  • Identify and implement innovative solutions for improved efficiencies and outcomes

  • Multilingual (preferably English/Spanish)

Workstyle: Remote

Location: Must reside within a 50-mile radius of one of the following locations:

  • Englwood Park

  • West Oakland

  • West Orange

  • Plant City

Schedule: M-F 8-5 Eastern

Travel: 5% - Typically, one (1) time quarterly for market meetings, as needed by the market

Work at Home Requirements: To ensure Home or Hybrid Home/Office employees’ ability to work effectively, the self-provided internet service of Home or Hybrid Home/Office employees must meet the following criteria: At minimum, a download speed of 25 Mbps and an upload speed of 10 Mbps is required; wireless, wired cable or DSL connection is suggested. In certain roles, the minimum recommended internet speed required by Humana may not be sufficient for business needs. Humana reserves the right to require associates to upgrade their internet service if necessary. Work from a dedicated space lacking ongoing interruptions to protect member PHI / HIPAA information.Travel: While this is a remote position, occasional travel to Humana's offices for training or meetings may be required.

Scheduled Weekly Hours

40

This incentive opportunity is based upon company and/or individual performance.

Description of Benefits

Humana, Inc. and its affiliated subsidiaries (collectively, “Humana”) offers competitive benefits that support whole-person well-being. Associate benefits are designed to encourage personal wellness and smart healthcare decisions for you and your family while also knowing your life extends outside of work. Among our benefits, Humana provides medical, dental and vision benefits, 401(k) retirement savings plan, time off (including paid time off, company and personal holidays, paid parental and caregiver leave), short-term and long-term disability, life insurance and many other opportunities.


About us

As part of Humana’s Primary Care Organization, which includes CenterWell Senior Primary Care, Conviva’s innovative, value-based approach means each patient gets the best care, when needed most, and for the lowest cost. jobs.description:
Job Posting Title:

Cybersecurity Threat and Vulnerability Analyst

----

Hiring Department:

Information Security Office

----

Position Open To:

All Applicants

----

Weekly Scheduled Hours:

40

----

FLSA Status:

Exempt from FLSA

----

Earliest Start Date:

Immediately

----

Position Duration:

Expected to Continue

----

Location:

UT MAIN CAMPUS

----

Job Details:

General Notes

Remote work allowed. Remote work for individuals who reside outside Texas but within the United States and its territories will be considered and requires Central Office approval.

The threat landscape we operate in requires a team to respond appropriately; therefore, please apply even if you are unsure if your experience is relevant. The most important ingredients for success on this team are a strong ability to think creatively about problems, very strong communication skills, and a passion to learn and share knowledge.

You will get to work with a very intelligent and dedicated team to address enterprise cybersecurity challenges through novel approaches in an office that highly values work-life balance, the freedom to explore out of the box ideas, and serving others.

Most importantly, you will help take our tools and ideas to the next level. What starts here changes the world!

Your skills will make a difference.

You’ll be working for a university that is internationally recognized for our academic programs and research. Your work will contribute to operational excellence and enhance the student experience. If you’re the type of person that wants to know your work has meaning and impact, you’ll like working in our department and for UT Austin. UT Austin provides an outstanding benefits package including but not limited to:

  • Competitive health benefits (employee premiums covered at 100%, family premiums at 50%)
  • Voluntary Vision, Dental, Life, and Disability insurance options
  • Generous paid vacation, sick time, and holidays
  • Teachers Retirement System of Texas, a defined benefit retirement plan, with employer matching funds
  • Additional Voluntary Retirement Programs: Tax Sheltered Annuity 403(b) and a Deferred Compensation program 457(b)
  • Flexible spending account options for medical and childcare expenses
  • Robust free training access through LinkedIn Learning plus professional conference opportunities
  • Tuition Assistance
  • Expansive employee discount program including athletic tickets
  • Free access to UT Austin's libraries and museums with staff ID card
  • Free rides on all UT Shuttle and Austin CapMetro buses with staff ID card

For more details, please see: and .

This position requires you to maintain Internet service and a mobile phone with voice and data plans to be used when required for work.

Must be authorized to work in the United States on a full-time basis for any employer without sponsorship.

Purpose

The Cybersecurity Threat and Vulnerability Analyst will collaborate with a small team of risk management engineers to evaluate daily threats relative to vulnerabilities present on campus and will develop response protocols and reports to effectively reduce risk and manage threats.

Responsibilities

  • Discover and investigate security vulnerabilities including zero days.
  • Analyze technical data of vulnerabilities to allow an appropriate assessment of priority and potential impact to campus.
  • Ensure accurate and timely publication of vulnerability measures and reports.
  • Provide regular quality improvement of the vulnerability management program, in particular automated processes, communication, and vulnerability alert scheduling.
  • Communicate and share technical knowledge with risk management team along with suggestions for prioritized approaches needed to address gaps in vulnerability management.
  • Assist the Information Security Office’s Risk Management team in performing: Vulnerability assessments, Risk Assessments, Zero Day exposure analysis and compensating controls.
  • Create reports and documentation for vulnerability management.
  • Stay informed of latest threats, security vulnerabilities, and recommend solutions for technology in use by the university.
  • Other related functions as assigned.

Required Qualifications

  • U.S. Citizen, resident, or officially recognized asylee - Applicant selected will be subject to government security investigation and must meet eligibility requirements for access to classified information at the level appropriate to the project requirements of the position.
  • At least 1 year of relevant experience supporting vulnerability management tools and technologies
  • Strong interest in the cybersecurity field
  • Excellent problem-solving and data analysis skills as well as a keen eye for detail to identify and resolve issues effectively
  • Ability to work independently and collaboratively, and ability to manage parallel activities in a fast-paced, dynamic team environment
  • Strong synchronous and asynchronous communication skills
  • Self-motivated to learn and share knowledge

Preferred Qualifications

  • Basic Python / Scripting skills
  • Strong familiarity with vulnerability measurement and rating systems (e.g., CVE, CVSS, CISA Known Exploited Vulnerabilities)
  • Basic knowledge of SIEM tools such as Splunk.
  • Basic knowledge of Linux Administration
  • Basic knowledge of vulnerability scanning tools such as Nmap and Tenable Nessus.

Salary Range

$75,000 + depending on qualifications

Working Conditions

  • May work around standard office conditions
  • Repetitive use of a keyboard at a workstation
  • Use of manual dexterity

Required Materials

  • Resume/CV
  • 3 work references with their contact information; at least one reference should be from a supervisor
  • Letter of interest

Importantfor applicants who are NOT current university employees or contingent workers: You will be prompted to submit your resume the first time you apply, then you will be provided an option to upload a new Resume for subsequent applications. Any additional Required Materials (letter of interest, references, etc.) will be uploaded in the Application Questions section; you will be able to multi-select additional files. Before submitting your online job application, ensure that ALL Required Materials have been uploaded. Once your job application has been submitted, you cannot make changes.

Important for Current university employees and contingent workers: As a current university employee or contingent worker, you MUST apply within Workday by searching for Find UT Jobs. If you are a current University employee, log-in to Workday, navigate to your Worker Profile, click the Career link in the left hand navigation menu and then update the sections in your Professional Profile before you apply. This information will be pulled in to your application. The application is one page and you will be prompted to upload your resume. In addition, you must respond to the application questions presented to upload any additional Required Materials (letter of interest, references, etc.) that were noted above.

----

Employment Eligibility:

Regular staff who have been employed in their current position for the last six continuous months are eligible for openings being recruited for through University-Wide or Open Recruiting, to include both promotional opportunities and lateral transfers. Staff who are promotion/transfer eligible may apply for positions without supervisor approval.

----

Retirement Plan Eligibility:

The retirement plan for this position is Teacher Retirement System of Texas (TRS), subject to the position being at least 20 hours per week and at least 135 days in length.

----

Background Checks:

A criminal history background check will be required for finalist(s) under consideration for this position.

----

Equal Opportunity Employer:

The University of Texas at Austin, as an equal opportunity/affirmative action employer, complies with all applicable federal and state laws regarding nondiscrimination and affirmative action. The University is committed to a policy of equal opportunity for all persons and does not discriminate on the basis of race, color, national origin, age, marital status, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, disability, religion, or veteran status in employment, educational programs and activities, and admissions.

----

Pay Transparency:

The University of Texas at Austin will not discharge or in any other manner discriminate against employees or applicants because they have inquired about, discussed, or disclosed their own pay or the pay of another employee or applicant. However, employees who have access to the compensation information of other employees or applicants as a part of their essential job functions cannot disclose the pay of other employees or applicants to individuals who do not otherwise have access to compensation information, unless the disclosure is (a) in response to a formal complaint or charge, (b) in furtherance of an investigation, proceeding, hearing, or action, including an investigation conducted by the employer, or (c) consistent with the contractor’s legal duty to furnish information.

----

Employment Eligibility Verification:

If hired, you will be required to complete the federal Employment Eligibility Verification I-9 form. You will be required to present acceptable and original documents to prove your identity and authorization to work in the United States. Documents need to be presented no later than the third day of employment. Failure to do so will result in loss of employment at the university.

----

E-Verify:

The University of Texas at Austin use E-Verify to check the work authorization of all new hires effective May 2015. The university’s company ID number for purposes of E-Verify is 854197. For more information about E-Verify, please see the following:

  • E-Verify Poster (English and Spanish) [PDF]
  • Right to Work Poster (English) [PDF]
  • Right to Work Poster (Spanish) [PDF]

----

Compliance:

Employees may be required to report violations of law under Title IX and the Jeanne Clery Disclosure of Campus Security Policy and Crime Statistics Act (Clery Act). If this position is identified a Campus Security Authority (Clery Act), you will be notified and provided resources for reporting. Responsible employees under Title IX are defined and outlined in HOP-3031.

The Clery Act requires all prospective employees be notified of the availability of the Annual Security and Fire Safety report. You may access the most recent report here or obtain a copy at University Compliance Services, 1616 Guadalupe Street, UTA 2.206, Austin, Texas 78701.

jobs.description:
Consultant Psychiatrist – Children and Young Persons Clinical Service Lead

United Kingdom (Remote)

Ref: CLIN001

Reporting to:Clinical Director for ASD, CYP and Old Age

Remuneration: £160,000 FTE, dependent upon experience- plus £1000 working from home allowance

Contract Type:﻿Permanent/ Part time - 32 hours per week (0.8FTE)

In addition, the post holder will have the opportunity to undertake clinical work through a separate contractor engagement, providing additional clinical capacity alongside their substantive role.

Location:Home-based/various UK meeting locations as required

Closing Date for applications:Friday 2nd October 2026*

About Us:

Psychiatry UK is the UK’s leading provider of digital psychiatry services, working both privately and with the NHS to support children, teenagers and adults with expert, patient-centred care.

A career with Psychiatry UK allows you to expand your knowledge, enhance your skills, and gain valuable life experience—all while enjoying the flexibility of a remote full-time role. As part of a leading online mental health service, you'll collaborate with innovative, forward-thinking professionals in a dynamic, multidisciplinary team committed to making a real difference.

The Consultant Psychiatrist – Children and Young Persons Clinical Service Lead plays a pivotal role within Psychiatry UK, providing expert clinical leadership to one of the UK's leading independent digital mental health providers. This is an exciting opportunity for an experienced Consultant Child & Adolescent Psychiatrist to shape the future of Children and Young People (CYP) services, influence clinical strategy, and drive innovation in the delivery of high-quality, patient-centred care.

Working in close partnership with the Clinical Director, the Clinical Lead will provide visible and credible clinical leadership, champion excellence in clinical governance, and support the continued growth and development of our multidisciplinary teams. The postholder will play a key role in ensuring safe, effective, evidence-based care while driving continuous quality improvement, enhancing patient outcomes, and supporting the strategic objectives of the organisation.

This role offers the opportunity to influence service development at a national level while maintaining a strong focus on clinical quality, patient safety, and operational excellence. The successful candidate will work collaboratively with clinical and operational leaders to ensure the continued delivery of innovative, accessible, and high-quality services for children and young people across the UK.

This is a home-based role (applicants must reside in the UK), offering genuine flexibility and work-life balance, although occasional travel may be required for face-to-face meetings at various locations within the UK.

As ourConsultant Psychiatrist – Children and Young Persons Clinical Service Lead, you will:

  • Provide clinical leadership for Psychiatry UK's Children and Young People (CYP) services, ensuring the delivery of safe, effective, evidence-based care and excellent patient outcomes.

  • Lead and support the multidisciplinary clinical team by providing expert clinical guidance, promoting best practice, and fostering a collaborative, inclusive, and high-performing culture.

  • Work in partnership with the Clinical Director and operational leaders to shape and develop CYP services, driving innovation, service transformation, and continuous quality improvement across the organisation.

  • Oversee clinical governance, ensuring services meet CQC, safeguarding, and regulatory standards while maintaining the highest levels of clinical quality and patient safety.

  • Monitor clinical performance, patient outcomes, and service quality, using data, audit findings, and patient feedback to identify opportunities for improvement and enhance clinical effectiveness.

  • Support the recruitment, induction, supervision, mentoring, and professional development of clinicians, helping to build a skilled, engaged, and resilient workforce.

  • Chair and contribute to multidisciplinary team (MDT) meetings, providing clinical oversight and supporting effective decision-making across the service.

  • Work collaboratively with operational colleagues to optimise clinical capacity, workforce planning, and patient pathways, ensuring timely access to high-quality care for children and young people.

  • Build strong relationships with internal and external stakeholders, supporting integrated working, service development, and the continued growth of Psychiatry UK's CYP services.

To succeed as ourConsultant Psychiatrist – Children and Young Persons Clinical Service Lead, you will be:

An experienced and inspirational Consultant Child & Adolescent Psychiatrist with a passion for clinical leadership, service improvement, and delivering exceptional patient care. You will be a credible and supportive leader, capable of inspiring multidisciplinary teams while building collaborative relationships across the organisation and with external partners.

You will possess excellent communication and interpersonal skills, demonstrate sound clinical judgement, and be confident making decisions within complex clinical environments. You will thrive in a dynamic and evolving healthcare setting, bringing a strategic mindset, strong organisational skills, and a commitment to continuous improvement, innovation, and high-quality patient-centred care.

Essential Qualifications, Skills and Experience:

  • Medical degree with postgraduate qualification (MRCPsych or equivalent).

  • Full GMC registration with a licence to practise and inclusion on the GMC Specialist Register for Child and Adolescent Psychiatry.

  • Extensive Consultant-level clinical experience in Child and Adolescent Psychiatry.

  • Demonstrable experience providing clinical leadership within a complex healthcare environment.

  • Experience leading, supervising, mentoring, and developing multidisciplinary clinical teams.

  • Evidence of participation in clinical audit, quality improvement, and service development initiatives.

  • Strong knowledge of clinical governance, safeguarding, patient safety, and compliance with relevant regulatory standards.

  • Extensive knowledge of evidence-based assessment and treatment approaches for ADHD, Autism Spectrum Disorder (ASD), and wider child and young people's mental health conditions.

Desirable Qualifications, Skills and Experience:

  • Experience delivering clinical education, teaching, or mentoring.

  • Research experience, including publications or presentations relating to mental health or Children and Young People (CYP).

  • Senior management qualification (e.g. MBA or equivalent).

  • Experience leading service development, transformation, or innovation projects within healthcare.

  • Experience of budget management and resource planning within clinical services.

  • Knowledge of epidemiology, healthcare evaluation, and statistical analysis relevant to mental health services.

  • Experience using clinical data and analytics to drive performance improvement and service delivery.

  • Project and change management experience, including supporting organisational development and workforce engagement.

  • Experience developing and implementing clinical risk management and safeguarding frameworks.

  • Strong IT skills, including experience using electronic health records, clinical databases, and reporting systems.

  • Commercial awareness with the ability to contribute to the strategic growth and development of Psychiatry UK's CYP services.

Psychiatry UK: Supporting You

We want you to enjoy your work while feeling healthy, happy, and appreciated. That’s why we’ve created a benefits package designed with you in mind. You’ll have access to a range of wellbeing perks, including a Health Cash Plan, Well Hub Subscription, access to an Employee Assistance Programme, Annual Volunteering Day, Enhanced Sickness and Family Leave pay, Length of Service Bonus, Work from Home allowance and Pension options.

At Psychiatry UK, we care about what matters to you.

Recruitment Process

﻿At Psychiatry UK, we are committed to creating an inclusive and accessible recruitment process. Our process includes:

·Application

·Profile review

·Screening conversation

·Competency based interview(s)

If at any point you require any reasonable adjustments —such as additional time, assistive technology, or an alternative format for materials—please let us know. We are happy to accommodate your needs to ensure you have a fair and comfortable experience.

If this opportunity excites you, why not apply today? *We review applications as they come in and may close the advert early if we receive a high volume of interest. To ensure you don’t miss out, we encourage you to submit your application as soon as possible.

jobs.excerpt: OverviewAs a Product Marketing Manager II, GTM Operations at AvidXchange, you will own the planning and execution behind the horizontal go-to-market, serving as the operational backbone that keeps launches on track, enablement current, research sharp, and reporting visible across the GTM organization.
jobs.description:
Overview

As a Product Marketing Manager II, GTM Operations at AvidXchange, you will own the planning and execution behind the horizontal go-to-market, serving as the operational backbone that keeps launches on track, enablement current, research sharp, and reporting visible across the GTM organization. You will build and run the systems, programs, and frameworks that allow GTM Strategists to focus on strategy, while personally ensuring partner launches are executed with precision, enablement assets reflect what the field needs, and market intelligence informs every decision. This is a high impact, high visibility role for someone who thrives in ambiguity, takes ownership without being asked, and is motivated by building scalable programs that drive measurable partner and buyer growth. For the right person, it is an opportunity to develop deep GTM expertise at the center of one of the company's highest priority growth areas.

What You Will Do

  • Launch Operations: Develop and maintain standardized launch playbooks and intake workflows that scale as the partner ecosystem grows
  • Go-to-Market: Develop and execute go-to-market for partner and buyer GTM Strategists, ensuring launches move from planning to market with speed and consistency.
  • Market Research and Intelligence: Conduct TAM, SAM, and SOM research for partner and buyer solutions to inform GTM strategy and ICP development, while supporting competitive intelligence gathering across the partner and buyer landscape and synthesizing findings into actionable summaries for GTM Strategists and leadership.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Serve as the primary execution resource for the Buyer and Partner GTM Strategists, translating strategic priorities into organized and delivered work while maintaining cross-functional alignment on messaging, positioning, and goals across Sales, Enablement, Onboarding, Operations, and Partner teams through active participation in planning sessions and field meetings.
  • Sales and Partner Enablement: Provide sales teams with the current, accessible, and field-tested tools, training, and materials they need to sell effectively, continuously refreshed with real feedback from weekly meetings, field calls, and partner onboarding sessions.
  • Reporting and KPI Tracking: Own reporting and data analysis across partner and buyer GTM workstreams, building and maintaining dashboards that track KPIs including content adoption, launch performance, win rates, and enablement usage, and surfacing trends and insights that inform PMM recommendations and strategic adjustments for GTM Strategists and leadership.

What We Are Looking For

  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in business, marketing, or related field.
  • Experience: 3+ years in product marketing or partner and channel marketing, preferably within Fintech, SaaS, or a high-growth technology environment. Experience with AP automation or financial software is a plus.
  • Research and Analytical Skills: Comfortable conducting TAM, SAM, and SOM research, synthesizing competitive intelligence, and translating data and market insights into clear and actionable recommendations.
  • Communication: Strong storyteller and communicator who can simplify complex topics, tailor messaging to diverse B2B audiences, and produce clear and concise written deliverables including enablement content and research summaries.
  • Execution: Self-starter with proven ability to plan, lead, and deliver multifaceted projects independently.
  • Operational Excellence: Highly organized self-starter with a proven ability to build, manage, and scale programs and processes across multiple concurrent workstreams without losing attention to detail or delivery quality.
  • Collaboration: Team-oriented professional with a passion for partnering across functions and helping others succeed.






About AvidXchange

AvidXchange is a leading provider of accounts payable (“AP”) automation software and payment solutions for middle-market businesses and their suppliers. By trade, we are a technology company, but if you ask anyone who works here, they’ll tell you our people are at the core of who we are. At AvidXchange, mindset is everything. We are Connected as People, Growth Minded, and Customer Obsessed. These three mindsets represent our culture – who we are, who we’ve always been, and they guide us to improve every day. Since our founding in 2000 in Charlotte, NC, we’ve created a company of over 1,500 teammates working across the U.S., or remotely. AvidXchange is proud to be Certified™ as a GreatPlace to Work®. The prestigious recognition is based on anonymous data from our teammates and makes official what our teammates have known for years – that AvidXchange is a Great Place to Work®.

Who you are:

  • A go-getter with an entrepreneurial mindset – that means you are not afraid of taking risks, winning big or facing the unknown.
  • Someone who understands that business is people centric. Connecting with others as humans first allows you to develop mutually beneficial working relationships.
  • Focused on making a difference for our customers. AvidXchange exists to help solve complex problems for our customers so we can all realize our potential.

What you’ll get:

AvidXchange teammates (we call them AvidXers) get the perks and prestige of a growing tech company paired with the flexibility of a founder-led startup. We help our AvidXers develop as professionals and as human beings, providing work/life balance, development programs, and competitive benefits. At AvidXchange, we are building more than a tech company – we are building an experience. We remain committed to a culture where you can fully be 'you’ – connected with others, chasing big goals, and making a meaningful impact. If you want to help us grow while realizing your potential and creating stories you’ll tell for years, you’ve come to the right place.

Position:Onboarding Project Manager - Marketing

Department: Client Delivery

Reports to: Operations Director

Role

The Onboarding Project Manager - Marketing is responsible for overseeing the onboarding, coordination, and launch of client marketing funnels and paid advertising campaigns for our Scale clients.

This role ensures that each client strategy moves efficiently from planning to execution by coordinating all required assets, managing team collaboration, and maintaining clear communication with clients throughout the onboarding and launch process.

The Onboarding Project Manager acts as the central project manager for client marketing builds — ensuring all components of the funnel and advertising strategy are completed on time, approved by the client, and launched with excellence.

Responsibilities

Client Onboarding & Project Management

➔ Manage and oversee the onboarding process for new clients to ensure a seamless and professional experience
➔ Take the approved client strategy and convert it into clear project plans and tasks for execution using Asana
➔ Create and manage all onboarding and build tasks in Asana so the team has clear direction and deadlines
➔ Coordinate all moving parts required to build and launch a client’s funnel and ads
➔ Maintain organization across multiple clients and projects simultaneously while ensuring deadlines are met
➔ Identify opportunities to streamline and improve onboarding and launch processes

Funnel & Asset Coordination

Task out all required funnel components to the appropriate team members including:

◆ Funnel copy

◆ Funnel design

◆ Funnel tech build

◆ Email automation
◆ Ad copy and ad creative

Ensure all funnel elements align with the client’s strategy and offer positioning
➔ Bring together all completed assets and confirm readiness for launch
➔ Review deliverables before client submission to ensure quality and clarity

Team Collaboration

Coordinate and manage the execution of projects across the following team members:

◆ Copywriter

◆ Graphic Designer

◆ Funnel Tech / Builder

◆ Ads Manager

  • Ensure each team member has clear expectations, timelines, and deliverables
  • Proactively follow up on deadlines and keep projects moving forward
  • Communicate updates and blockers quickly so solutions can be implemented

Client Communication

  • Serve as the primary point of contact during the onboarding and build phase
  • Manage client communication related to project progress, deliverables, and approvals
  • Present completed assets to clients for review and approval
  • Gather feedback and coordinate revisions with the team when necessary
  • Ensure the client experience is organized, efficient, and positive

Launch Coordination

  • Confirm all funnel and advertising assets are completed, approved, and ready for launch
  • Coordinate with the ads manager to ensure campaigns are launched successfully
  • Ensure all funnel tracking, links, and automations are functioning correctly prior to launch
  • Move clients from onboarding to active campaign management as efficiently as possible without sacrificing strategy depth or quality

Results

  • Client funnels and advertising campaigns are launched quickly and efficiently after onboarding
  • All required assets are coordinated and completed on time by the team
  • Clients experience a seamless, professional onboarding and launch process
  • Communication between the client and internal team is clear, proactive, and organized
  • Team members have clear direction and deadlines for every project task
  • No deadlines or deliverables fall through the cracks
  • Multiple client projects can run simultaneously without loss of organization or quality
  • Funnels and ads are launched only after meeting quality standards and client approval
  • Processes for onboarding and launching clients continually improve and become more efficient

Requirements

  • 2+ years of experience in digital marketing, project management, or marketing coordination
  • Solid understanding of marketing funnels, online offers, and paid advertising systems
  • No struggles with being inside a high pressure, high performance environment
  • Ability to see how all pieces of a funnel fit together from strategy to execution
  • Strong project management and organizational skills
  • Experience managing multiple projects or clients simultaneously
  • Ability to coordinate and delegate tasks to multiple team members
  • Strong attention to detail and commitment to quality
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills
  • Proactive problem-solving mindset and ability to move projects forward independently
  • Experience with project management software (Asana preferred)
  • A passion for organization, systems, and improving operational efficiency
  • Ability to maintain urgency and move projects forward quickly without sacrificing quality
  • A collaborative mindset and ability to work effectively across teams
Salary: $28 – $30 / hour

jobs.title: (Senior) Software Engineer // Odoo Developer (m/w/d)
jobs.excerpt: Deine RolleBei uns bist du Teil des Teams – kein Backoffice-Job.
jobs.description:
Deine Rolle

Bei uns bist du Teil des Teams – kein Backoffice-Job. Als Entwickler sitzt du nicht isoliert hinter deinem Terminal, sondern arbeitest nah an Kunden und Beratung. Du hilfst mit, Lösungen zu finden und zu erarbeiten, statt nur fertige Tickets abzuarbeiten.

Konkret heißt das:

  • Du entwickelst, erweiterst und integrierst Odoo-Lösungen für unsere Kunden – von der Anforderung bis zur produktiven Lösung.
  • Du arbeitest an unseren Standardprodukten mit und kannst dort echte Produktverantwortung übernehmen. Du bist also nicht nur in wechselnden Projekten unterwegs, sondern entwickelst Produkte, die wachsen und bleiben.
  • Du unterstützt unsere Kunden und die Beratung bei der Lösungsfindung – technisch, pragmatisch und auf Augenhöhe.
  • Du bringst neue Themen in unsere eigene Infrastruktur und Prozesse ein. Für unsere internen Abläufe entstehen laufend neue Anforderungen, die verankert und eingebunden werden wollen – hier gestaltest du aktiv mit.

Das bringst du mit:

  • Eigenverantwortung: Du arbeitest selbstständig, übernimmst Verantwortung für deine Themen und treibst sie voran, ohne dass man dich schieben muss.
  • Technologische Offenheit und Breite: Du legst dich nicht auf eine einzige Technologie fest, sondern arbeitest dich gern in Neues ein. Python und das Odoo-Framework sind dein Zuhause oder werden es schnell; XML, PostgreSQL, JavaScript/OWL, REST-APIs und Git sind dir vertraut oder reizen dich. Mit Docker und Linux kommst du klar, und der Umgang mit CI/CD-Pipelines ist dir vertraut oder du willst da rein. Kubernetes ist ein nettes Extra, aber kein Muss.
  • Kundenkontakt liegt dir: Du kannst auch im direkten Austausch mit Kunden bestehen, hörst zu, übersetzt zwischen Fachlichkeit und Technik und vertrittst Lösungen souverän.
  • Engagement für Neues: Neue Themen, Produkte und Projekte siehst du als Chance, nicht als Last. Du engagierst dich und denkst über den Tellerrand der einzelnen Aufgabe und des einzelnen Projektes hinaus.
  • Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse: Du arbeitest eng mit unseren Kunden – fließendes Deutsch in Wort und Schrift ist deshalb wichtig.

Was uns wichtiger ist als jede einzelne Zeile auf dieser Liste: eine kooperative, lösungsorientierte und professionelle Zusammenarbeit. Genau das schätzen wir – und genau das schätzen unsere Kunden an uns.

Erste Berufserfahrung reicht völlig. Du musst kein Odoo-Veteran sein – wichtiger ist, dass du Lust hast, schnell zu lernen und Verantwortung zu übernehmen. Du erfüllst nicht jeden Punkt der Liste? Bewirb dich trotzdem. Uns interessiert, was du mitbringst und mitbringen willst, nach dem Motto: Der Rohdiamant ist selten schon geschliffen.

Schön, aber kein Muss: Erfahrung in der Beratung oder Entwicklung im B2B-Umfeld; Erfahrung im ERP-Umfeld oder mit der Betreuung eigener Softwareprodukte.

Was wir dir bieten

Bei ODION bieten wir dir eine steile Lernkurve, viel Verantwortung und ein warmherziges Team, in dem Professionalität und Teamgeist im Einklang stehen. Außerdem profitierst du von einer Vielzahl an Corporate Benefits:

  • Unbefristeter Vertrag: Stabilität und Sicherheit sind die Grundlage unseres Erfolgs und deiner Karriere.
  • Mobilität: Ob Firmenfahrzeug, Deutschland-Ticket oder Jobrad – wir sorgen dafür, dass du mobil bleibst.
  • Steuerfreie Gehaltsextras: Vom Warengutschein über Essenszuschüsse bis zu weiteren Angeboten unterstützen wir dich in deinem Alltag.
  • Erholung und Entspannung: 30 Tage Urlaub pro Jahr, damit du dich richtig erholst.
  • Flexibilität im Arbeitsalltag: Homeoffice, Handy-/Internetkostenübernahme und Parkplätze – du arbeitest flexibel, ob im Büro, remote oder als Workation.
  • Zukunftssicherheit: Mit unserem Beitrag zur betrieblichen Altersvorsorge denken wir an deine Zukunft.
  • Kontinuierliche Weiterbildung: Regelmäßige Schulungen, Workshops und Zugang zu vielfältigen Lernressourcen bringen dich weiter.
  • Wohlfühlatmosphäre: Von kalten und warmen Getränken über Snacks bis zur „immer gut gefüllten Süßigkeitenschublade" – bei uns darfst du dich wohlfühlen.
  • Team-Events: Regelmäßige Events stärken unseren Zusammenhalt.
  • Bring your Dog: Deinen Vierbeiner musst du nicht zu Hause lassen – bei uns ist er willkommen.

Klingt nach dir?

Dann lass uns reden. Schick uns deine Bewerbung. Dein Lebenslauf reicht erst einmal, ein klassisches Anschreiben brauchen wir nicht. Erzähl uns lieber kurz von dir und was dich an der Rolle reizt.

Wir freuen uns auf deine Bewerbung!

Digitalisierung? Wir machen's einfach.

Und genau dafür brauchen wir dich.

Gestartet in der Region Saar-Lor-Lux und Rheinland-Pfalz, sind wir heute im gesamten DACH-Raum für unsere Kunden tätig. Unser Kundenkreis ist dabei breit gefächert – vom produzierenden Gewerbe über Großhandel, Pharma und Food bis hin zu Service- und IT-Unternehmen. Seit über zehn Jahren setzen wir auf Odoo als technische Basis und ergänzen es mit eigenen Produkten – von über 500 selbst entwickelten Modulen bis hin zu Lösungen wie ODION Mobile, ODION Digital Factory und vielen weiteren.

Was uns antreibt, ist nicht das nächste Buzzword, sondern die Frage: Wie machen wir die Arbeit unserer Kunden tatsächlich einfacher?

Für dich heißt das: steile Lernkurve, früh echte Verantwortung und ein Team, das dich dabei trägt. Ob du gerade aus dem Studium kommst oder schon deine ersten Jahre Berufserfahrung gesammelt hast – bei uns wächst du schnell.

Alignment Health is breaking the mold in conventional health care, committed to serving seniors and those who need it most: the chronically ill and frail. It takes an entire team of passionate and caring people, united in our mission to put the senior first.We have built a team of talented and experienced people who are passionate about transforming the lives of the seniors we serve. Working at Alignment Health provides an opportunity to do work that really matters, not only changing lives but saving them. Together.

Alignment Healthcare is a data and technology driven healthcare company focused on partnering with health systems, health plans, and provider groups to provide care delivery that is preventive, convenient, coordinated, and that results in improved clinical outcomes for seniors.
We are seeking a mission-driven Data Scientist to join our growing Stars team, with a primary focus on HOS (Health Outcomes Survey) — the functional health and outcomes survey component of our Star Ratings strategy. This role is responsible for modeling member-level physical and mental health trajectories, identifying the clinical and operational drivers behind HOS measure performance, and translating those insights into targeted interventions that move specific Star Rating cut points.
This is a unique opportunity to work at the intersection of healthcare, clinical outcomes, and survey methodology — directly shaping the strategy behind one of the most influential and least understood components of the Star Ratings program.

GENERAL DUTIES/RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Collaborate with Stars, clinical, and care management leaders to understand HOS performance drivers and translate them into analytical solutions.
  • Segment members by likelihood to respond to the HOS survey and by predicted physical or mental health trajectory, to prioritize outreach and intervention.
  • Build and fine-tune models predicting member-level risk of HOS composite decline, including Improving/Maintaining Physical Health, Improving/Maintaining Mental Health, Monitoring Physical Activity, and Reducing the Risk of Falling.
  • Analyze item-level HOS survey data, not just composite scores, to isolate which specific survey questions are driving measure performance.
  • Build pipelines that track HOS survey administration cycles — baseline and follow-up cohorts, sampling, fielding, and response rates — and validate case-mix adjustment logic against CMS methodology.
  • Model statistical significance and year-over-year variance to distinguish genuine performance shifts from survey noise or sampling error.
  • Coordinate with HOS survey vendors on cohort tracking, sampling methodology, fielding timelines, and case-mix adjustment specifications.
  • Collaborate with engineering teams to version, test, and deploy models using Git, CI/CD pipelines, and virtual machine (VM) environments.
  • Partner with clinical, care management, complex case management, Compliance, and Legal teams to ensure HOS-related data outputs and interventions align with CMS guidance.
  • Build dashboards tracking measure-level HOS performance against Star Rating cut points and prior-year trend for each composite.
  • Help standardize definitions, documentation logic, and reporting workflows to scale HOS analytics enterprise-wide.

jobs.description:
About MD Integrations

At MD Integrations, we partner with digital health brands to power clinical care at scale. We specialize in men's and women’s health, dermatology, endocrinology, and weight management, offering telehealth solutions that help patients receive expert, personalized care—all from the comfort of their home. Join our team and be part of the movement to make specialty care more accessible and impactful.

MD Integrations is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. We are unable to support US visa sponsorship at this time.

The Forward Deploy Engineer is the central point of contact and technical liaison for MDI customers in active implementation and supporting existing customers as they expand their integration offerings. You’ll lead the technical implementation process from kickoff to go-live, mapping and configuring API connections, reviewing logs, and troubleshooting issues to keep integrations on track.

This role is ideal for someone technically literate and highly comfortable working with APIs who enjoys problem-solving, learning new systems, and explaining complex concepts clearly to non-technical customers. This is not a software engineering role: you won’t be writing production code, but you will need to be confident configuring, testing, and debugging API connections independently. You’ll partner closely with the partner success and engineering teams, escalating clearly documented issues when they’re beyond the scope of this role.

Key Responsibilities

  1. Serve as the technical point of contact for new customers throughout implementation, and for existing customers expanding their integration footprint, guiding each engagement from kickoff through go-live.
  2. Lead the end-to-end technical implementation process, mapping and configuring API connections with customers and validating setup over screen share in real time. The average implementation timeline is days, not months.
  3. Monitor logs, dashboards, and tools like Postman to identify when APIs are misconfigured or behaving unexpectedly, and independently resolve the majority of issues without engineering involvement.
  4. Draft clear technical documentation for each issue encountered, including root cause, steps taken, and resolution, to build a reliable internal record and knowledge base.
  5. Escalate unresolved or complex issues to engineering with well-documented context, ensuring a smooth handoff and minimal back-and-forth.
  6. Translate customer inquiries and data needs into clear technical tasks and configuration notes, acting as the bridge between customer expectations and technical execution.
  7. Partner with the Partner Success Managers and Clinical Support teams to align technical capabilities with customer expectations throughout the relationship.
  8. Identify recurring issues or friction points across implementations and recommend ways to simplify, document, or automate the process.
  9. Maintain a high level of responsiveness, ownership, and customer empathy across both the finite implementation period and ongoing expansion work.

Success Looks Like…

  • Quick integration timelines driving a seamless go-live.
  • High customer satisfaction scores during integration and beyond.
  • Low number of escalations needing hands-on engineering resources.
  • Accuracy and completeness of documentation.
  • Responsiveness and collaboration across technical and customer teams.

Required Qualifications

  • 3+ years’ experience in a customer-facing technical support or implementation role with an emphasis on API-driven applications. Must be comfortable working with customers’ technical teams live, troubleshooting on video calls.
  • Strong understanding of APIs, webhooks, JSON payloads, and HTTP status codes; comfortable reading logs and API documentation to identify root cause and resolve configuration issues without engineering support.
  • Familiarity with data mapping, payload structures, or basic scripting (Python, JavaScript, or SQL).
  • Experience using tools such as HubSpot, Postman or equivalent for troubleshooting and testing API calls.
  • Technically-savvy and able to communicate technical concepts and processes to both technical and non-technical users. This is a technical support/implementation role, not a software development role, so you won’t be writing production code, but you should be able to independently resolve the majority of configuration and integration issues you encounter.
  • Experience documenting integration processes or producing customer-facing support materials for internal and external use including workflows, process diagrams and SOPs.
  • High attention to detail and organization; able to manage multiple projects and stakeholders simultaneously.
  • Demonstrated curiosity and ability to learn new systems, data flows, and integration logic quickly.
  • Customer-first mindset: you thrive in helping customers solve problems and find clarity.
  • Experience in SaaS or healthcare technology integrations, a plus.

What We Offer

  • Competitive Salary: The targeted range for this mid-level position is $72,500 - $85,000 per year, DOE.
  • Comprehensive Benefits: Our benefits package includes health, dental, and vision insurance with generous subsidy, company-covered life and disability insurance, and 401(k) with match for full-time, US-based employees.
  • Professional Development Opportunities: We are committed to investing in our employees' professional development and offer a variety of on the job training and growth opportunities.
  • Flexible Work Arrangements: We are a fully remote team who collaborate both synchronously and asynchronously to achieve the best outcomes.
  • Collaborative and Supportive Work Environment: We foster a collaborative and supportive work environment where employees are encouraged to share ideas and contribute to the company's success.

As a Senior Data Engineer at Chip, you'll help bring our data platform to the next level and empower Chip to be a truly data-driven business. You'll co-own the architecture of our data platform alongside our Analytics Engineer — not just implementing designs, but making the calls on how ingestion, modelling, and the semantic layer should actually work. You'll also provide technical leadership across the wider data engineering team as we grow.

What you can expect to be doing:

Architecture & Pipeline Design

  • Design, build, and run scalable, secure data pipelines across multiple sources — with an eye on compute sizing and query performance

  • Co-own architecture decisions across ingestion, modelling, and the presentation layer — defining how the platform should work, not just building to spec

  • Design and evolve our medallion architecture (Bronze, Silver, Gold) as the platform matures

Engineering Standards

  • Define more detailed engineering standards — naming conventions, partitioning, testing strategy, contract templates

  • Apply Databricks best practices and Infrastructure as Code across the platform

Data Governance

  • Own governance patterns in Unity Catalog — permissions, access models, and how we handle sensitive data

  • Set technical governance standards the rest of the team builds against

Enablement & Self-Service

  • Enable downstream consumers with self-service patterns, so the data team isn't the bottleneck for every request

Technical Leadership & Mentoring

  • Provide technical leadership across the data engineering team — mentoring other engineers, reviewing code, and raising the engineering bar

What we’re looking for:

  • Data engineering: You've built and scaled complex data products in a growing environment — you've seen platforms mature past their early ad hoc stage and know what that evolution actually takes.

  • Databricks expertise: Deep, hands-on knowledge of the Databricks platform end to end — workspace and compute configuration, governance, orchestration, user management, engineering best practices.

  • Data modelling: You're comfortable designing schemas and data models, including medallion architecture and Kimball/Star Schema concepts (Fact and Dimension tables), from the ground up.

  • Git: You're fluent in Git workflows — branching, troubleshooting, code reviews.

  • Python/PySpark/SQL: You write clean, efficient code across all three, and you understand how it performs at scale.

  • Database management: Experience with SQL/NoSQL databases (e.g., Redshift, Postgres, MongoDB), with a solid grounding in database fundamentals — indexing, performance, design trade-offs.

  • Mentoring: You've supported and grown less experienced engineers before, and enjoy doing it.

🚀 Únete al claustro de preparadores de Polaris x Ucademy

¿Eres policía, guardia civil, funcionario/a de prisiones o preparas estas oposiciones? Colabora en remoto con Polaris x Ucademy y ayuda a otros a conseguir su plaza.

📚 Oposiciones para las que buscamos preparadores

  • Policía Nacional (Escala Básica)

  • Guardia Civil (Escala de Cabos y Guardias)

  • Policía Municipal de Madrid

  • Policía Local de Andalucía

  • Policía Local de la Comunitat Valenciana

  • Ayudante de Instituciones Penitenciarias (Subgrupo C1)

  • Otras oposiciones de FYCSE

🌟 Quiénes somos

En Polaris x Ucademy preparamos oposiciones de una forma más digital, práctica y personalizada. Ya hemos acompañado a miles de opositores y tenemos un objetivo claro: que 10.000 personas consigan su plaza preparándose con nosotros.

Para lograrlo, estamos ampliando nuestro claustro de preparadores de alto rendimiento.

Somos muy digitales, pero lo humano no se negocia. La tecnología nos ayuda a enseñar mejor, y son nuestros preparadores quienes aportan conocimiento, criterio, cercanía y acompañamiento.

🔎 A quién buscamos

  • Agentes y funcionarios/as en activo o en excedencia (Policía Nacional, Guardia Civil, policías locales o Instituciones Penitenciarias) y preparadores/as de estas oposiciones.

  • Personas que conozcan el proceso completo por dentro: temario, psicotécnicos, ortografía, pruebas físicas, entrevista personal y reconocimiento médico.

  • Quienes sepan enseñar y acompañar: explicar con claridad, dar feedback útil y ayudar a sostener la preparación hasta el final.

  • Soltura con herramientas digitales. Si ya utilizas IA en tu día a día, mucho mejor.

🎯 En qué podrás colaborar

Según tu perfil, especialidad y disponibilidad, podrás participar en uno o varios proyectos:

  • Clases online dinámicas, prácticas y cercanas.

  • Temario y actualización normativa, clave en estas convocatorias.

  • Preguntas tipo test, psicotécnicos y simulacros con el formato real del examen.

  • Preparación de las pruebas físicas: planes de entrenamiento, técnica y seguimiento.

  • Entrevista personal y pruebas de personalidad: simulacros y feedback.

  • Seguimiento de alumnos: resolver dudas y ayudarles a avanzar.

  • Vídeos cortos, esquemas y resúmenes.

🤝 Cómo funciona la colaboración

No es un puesto de trabajo a jornada completa ni parcial. Colaborarás con Polaris x Ucademy mediante prestación de servicios en proyectos educativos concretos, compatible con tu actividad profesional.

Si estás en activo, no te pedimos que dejes tu puesto. Queremos que pongas tu experiencia al servicio de otros opositores de una forma flexible.

🌍 100 % remoto
🕐 Horarios y disponibilidad a convenir
📚 Proyectos y entregables definidos desde el inicio
💰 Compensación competitiva según el proyecto y los entregables

🎬 Cómo es el proceso de selección

Queremos conocerte enseñando, no solo leyendo tu CV. El proceso tiene cuatro pasos:

1. Revisión de perfil. En la candidatura responderás a unas preguntas breves y nos enviarás un vídeo de presentación de 1 minuto. Grábalo con el móvil, sin complicaciones: cuéntanos quién eres, tu experiencia y qué oposición dominas.

2. Contacto de validación. Si tu perfil encaja, nos pondremos en contacto contigo por llamada o por escrito para resolver dudas, conocer tu disponibilidad y explicarte cómo colaboramos.

3. Clase de prueba. Te pediremos que nos envíes una clase grabada de máximo 5 minutos sobre un concepto de tu oposición, con un material de apoyo creado por ti. No buscamos una producción perfecta: queremos ver cómo explicas y cómo haces sencillo lo difícil.

4. Entrevista. Si tu clase encaja, te invitaremos a una entrevista para conocerte mejor, comentar tu clase y hablar de los proyectos en los que podrías colaborar.

Si conoces el camino hacia una plaza y quieres ayudar a otros a recorrerlo, queremos conocerte.

👉 Únete al claustro de preparadores de Polaris x Ucademy.

Location: Remote (U.S.)

Employment Type: Part-Time Contract (20–25 hours per week)

About NeoReach

NeoReach is a creator-technology company and influencer marketing leader trusted by Fortune 500 brands, global enterprises, and disruptive startups to deliver campaigns that move culture and drive real business outcomes.

We blend agency excellence with technology innovation, powering programs through proprietary creator-data infrastructure, performance tools, AI-enabled workflows, and a platform ecosystem that makes influencer marketing more intelligent, more scalable, and more ROI-driven.

In addition to NeoReach, our growing ecosystem includes Influencers.com, a creator-focused platform dedicated to helping creators grow their businesses, build stronger communities, and unlock new opportunities.

As we continue to invest in brand growth and thought leadership, we're looking for a creative and highly organized Social Media Manager to help expand our presence across multiple social channels.

Role Overview

The Social Media Manager will be responsible for executing and managing social media strategy across both NeoReach and Influencers.com. This role will own content scheduling, content creation, community engagement, and social media performance reporting while helping amplify company thought leadership, research, product launches, industry insights, and event activations.

This is a hands-on role for someone who understands social media best practices, content marketing, and the creator economy. The ideal candidate is equal parts strategist, creator, and operator—capable of turning ideas into engaging content while maintaining consistency across multiple brands and platforms.

Platforms Managed

NeoReach

  • LinkedIn
  • Instagram
  • TikTok

Influencers.com

  • LinkedIn
  • Instagram
  • TikTok
  • YouTube

Key Responsibilities

Content Planning and Publishing

  • Manage social media calendars across NeoReach and Influencers.com
  • Schedule and publish content across all social platforms
  • Maintain consistent brand voice and posting cadence
  • Coordinate content around company announcements, reports, webinars, events, and product launches
  • Work closely with marketing leadership to execute social media initiatives

Content Creation and Repurposing

  • Create platform-specific content including graphics, carousels, short-form videos, captions, and social copy
  • Repurpose blogs, reports, podcasts, webinars, and long-form content into social assets
  • Edit and publish short-form video content for LinkedIn, Instagram Reels, TikTok, YouTube Shorts, and other emerging platforms
  • Identify social trends and opportunities that align with company objectives

Community Engagement and Brand Building

  • Monitor comments, messages, and mentions across all channels
  • Engage with creators, clients, prospects, and industry professionals
  • Support audience growth through proactive engagement and relationship building
  • Identify opportunities to participate in relevant industry conversations

Analytics and Optimization

  • Track and report on key social media performance metrics
  • Analyze engagement, reach, follower growth, and content performance
  • Provide recommendations to improve content effectiveness and audience growth
  • Test new formats, features, and content strategies across platforms

Thought Leadership Support

  • Support executive thought leadership initiatives across social channels
  • Repurpose leadership insights into engaging social content
  • Amplify company research, speaking engagements, media placements, and industry reports
  • Assist in promoting company attendance at major industry events

Requirements

Experience and Skills

  • Chronically online
  • 2+ years of experience managing social media for a brand, agency, creator, or media company
  • Strong understanding of LinkedIn, Instagram, TikTok, and YouTube best practices
  • Experience creating and editing short-form video content
  • Excellent writing, communication, and copywriting skills
  • Strong organizational and project management abilities
  • Experience using content scheduling and social media management tools

Creative and Execution Mindset

  • Ability to manage multiple brands and priorities simultaneously
  • Strong attention to detail and commitment to quality
  • Comfortable working independently with minimal oversight
  • Proactive, self-directed, and highly accountable
  • Ability to move quickly while maintaining consistency and accuracy

Industry Interest

  • Strong interest in influencer marketing, social media, digital marketing, and the creator economy
  • Familiarity with creator platforms and social media trends
  • Experience within influencer marketing, creator economy, SaaS, or advertising is a plus

Success Criteria

  • Consistent execution of social content calendars across both brands
  • Growth in engagement, reach, and audience across key social channels
  • Timely publishing of content and campaign support initiatives
  • Strong community engagement and audience interaction
  • High-quality content production across video, graphic, and written formats
  • Accurate and actionable monthly performance reporting

Benefits

Own Social Strategy Across Two Growing Brands

You will play a key role in shaping the social presence of both NeoReach and Influencers.com while helping drive awareness and engagement across the creator economy.

High Visibility and Impact

Your work will directly support company growth, thought leadership, product marketing, and brand awareness initiatives.

Create Content That Reaches Industry Leaders

You'll help tell stories that reach brands, agencies, creators, and marketing decision-makers around the world.

Build Expertise in the Creator Economy

You'll gain firsthand exposure to influencer marketing, creator technology, social media strategy, and emerging industry trends while working alongside one of the industry's leading teams.

Outbound Sales Development Representative – Remote

Position Type: Full-Time, Remote
Working Hours: U.S. Business Hours

About the Role

At Pavago, one of our clients is hiring a highly driven and results-oriented Outbound Sales Development Representative (SDR) to help build and scale their outbound sales function.

This is not a lead-following role.

You’ll be responsible for building your own prospect lists, executing multi-channel outbound campaigns, booking qualified meetings, and maintaining a healthy sales pipeline. Success in this role comes from proactively creating opportunities through cold calling, cold emailing, and LinkedIn outreach—not waiting for inbound leads.

If you’re competitive, resilient, and thrive on opening doors with decision-makers, this role offers significant growth potential within a fast-growing marketing agency serving the home services industry.

What You’ll Own

Outbound Prospecting & Lead Generation

  • Execute high-volume outbound prospecting through:
    • Cold calls
    • Cold emails
    • LinkedIn outreach
  • Identify and engage decision-makers within target companies.
  • Build and maintain your own prospecting lists using sales tools and research.
  • Generate qualified opportunities for the closing team.
  • Maintain consistent daily outreach activity across multiple channels.

Appointment Setting & Pipeline Development

  • Book qualified meetings with prospective clients.
  • Qualify prospects using established criteria before scheduling appointments.
  • Improve meeting attendance through effective follow-up and communication.
  • Maintain a healthy pipeline of opportunities.
  • Partner closely with Account Executives to ensure smooth handoffs.

Objection Handling & Sales Execution

  • Handle objections confidently and professionally.
  • Navigate gatekeepers and decision-makers effectively.
  • Build rapport and communicate value quickly.
  • Continuously improve scripts, messaging, and outreach strategies.
  • Test new approaches to increase conversion rates.

CRM & Sales Operations

  • Maintain accurate CRM records and pipeline updates.
  • Log call notes, outreach activities, and follow-up tasks.
  • Track opportunity stages and sales activity.
  • Ensure CRM hygiene and reporting accuracy.

Reporting & Performance

  • Report daily and weekly outreach activity.
  • Track meetings booked and pipeline performance.
  • Monitor key sales metrics and identify improvement opportunities.
  • Take ownership of personal performance and quota attainment.

What Success Looks Like

  • Consistently books qualified meetings.
  • Maintains high outbound activity across multiple channels.
  • Achieves strong meeting attendance rates.
  • Generates a predictable pipeline of sales opportunities.
  • Maintains clean CRM records and accurate reporting.
  • Contributes directly to business growth through outbound sales.

What Makes You a Strong Fit

  • You genuinely enjoy outbound prospecting.
  • You’re motivated by competition and measurable goals.
  • You thrive on opening conversations with new prospects.
  • You remain persistent and positive after rejection.
  • You take ownership of your performance without constant supervision.
  • You continuously improve your outreach strategy based on results.

Required Experience & Skills

Experience

  • Proven experience as:
    • Sales Development Representative (SDR)
    • Appointment Setter
    • Business Development Representative (BDR)
    • Outbound Sales Representative
  • Demonstrated success achieving or exceeding outbound sales targets.
  • Experience executing multi-channel outbound prospecting through:
    • Cold calling
    • Cold emailing
    • LinkedIn outreach
  • Strong objection-handling and prospecting skills.
  • Proven ability to book qualified meetings with decision-makers.
  • Experience maintaining CRM accuracy and managing pipelines.
  • Excellent written and spoken English communication skills.
  • Strong organizational and time-management abilities.
  • Ability to work independently with minimal supervision.
  • Ability to provide measurable performance metrics such as:
    • Meetings booked
    • Show-up rates
    • Call volume
    • Conversion rates
    • Quota attainment

Nice to Have

  • Experience selling to U.S.-based clients.
  • Background in:
    • B2B sales
    • Marketing services
    • Agency sales
  • Experience selling into the home services industry.
  • Experience using:
    • Salesforce
    • HubSpot
    • Similar CRM platforms
  • Familiarity with:
    • CloudTalk
    • Aircall
    • Similar dialers
  • Experience using LinkedIn Sales Navigator.
  • Exposure to AI tools, SaaS, or startup environments.

Tech Stack

  • Salesforce
  • HubSpot
  • LinkedIn Sales Navigator
  • CloudTalk
  • Aircall
  • Google Workspace
  • Microsoft Office
  • AI productivity tools (ChatGPT or similar)

What a Typical Day Looks Like

  • Review your pipeline and prioritize follow-ups.
  • Conduct cold calls and outbound prospecting.
  • Send personalized cold emails and LinkedIn messages.
  • Qualify prospects and overcome objections.
  • Schedule meetings for the sales team.
  • Update CRM records and pipeline stages.
  • Review outreach metrics and refine messaging.
  • Collaborate with the closing team to ensure smooth handoffs.

In short: You’ll build pipeline from scratch by prospecting, qualifying decision-makers, booking meetings, and creating consistent outbound opportunities that drive business growth.

Key Metrics for Success (KPIs)

  • Outbound calls completed.
  • Cold emails and LinkedIn outreach activity.
  • Qualified meetings booked.
  • Meeting attendance (show-up) rate.
  • Lead-to-meeting conversion rate.
  • Pipeline growth and opportunity creation.
  • CRM accuracy and activity tracking.
  • Quota attainment.

Why This Role Stands Out

  • High ownership over outbound sales and pipeline generation.
  • Opportunity to shape and grow the outbound sales function.
  • Direct impact on company revenue and growth.
  • Fully remote work environment.
  • Performance-driven culture with significant career advancement opportunities.
  • Career progression into:
    • Senior SDR
    • Business Development Manager
    • Account Executive
    • Sales Manager

Interview Process

  1. Application Review
  2. Spark Hire Intro Video (3–5 minutes)
  3. Client Interview
  4. Offer & Onboarding

What Happens After You Apply

After submitting your application, you’ll receive an email invitation from Spark Hire to record a short 3–5 minute Intro Video. This is the first step in our hiring process and can be completed whenever it’s convenient for you.

Instead of multiple initial screening calls, you’ll have one opportunity to introduce yourself, discuss your outbound sales experience, and explain how you’ve built prospect lists, handled cold calling, managed objection handling, and consistently booked qualified meetings. You’ll also have the opportunity to highlight your outbound performance metrics, CRM experience, and ability to work independently in a target-driven environment. Your video will be reviewed by the hiring team before moving to the client interview.

You can record your video as many times as you’d like before submitting it—only your final version will be reviewed.

Please keep an eye on both your inbox and spam folder for your Spark Hire invitation after applying.

Apply Now

If you’re passionate about outbound sales, enjoy creating opportunities from scratch, and thrive in a performance-driven environment, we’d love to hear from you. Apply today and help drive business growth through high-quality outbound prospecting and lead generation.

The business landscape is changing fast. From Day One is a media outlet and conference series that helps companies navigate all that change in ways that put people first.

  • You motivate and energize colleagues rather than waiting for inspiration.

  • You are excited about your work and bring urgency to your mission.
  • You approach challenges with enthusiasm and optimism.

By maintaining this optimistic outlook, we not only motivate ourselves but also uplift those around us. We believe that believing that the future will be better is the first step towards making it better -- for others, and for ourselves personally.

This is an independent contractor telehealth opportunity designed for therapists who enjoy autonomy, flexibility, and the ability to manage their own caseload while still being connected to a supportive pediatric therapy team.

Successful therapists in this role are confident providing the full scope of occupational therapy services through telehealth, including evaluations, treatment sessions, and ongoing patient care.

  • Complete initial evaluations and required re-evaluations for patients on your caseload
  • Develop individualized plans of care based on clinical findings, family goals, and patient needs

  • Help children improve functional skills and independence in daily activities

👨‍👩‍👧 Partner With Families

  • Provide coaching, education, and strategies to families, caregivers, and teachers
  • Help carry over therapeutic goals into home and community environments

📈 Monitor Progress

  • Track and document patient progress
  • Adjust treatment plans as needed
  • Communicate updates with families and healthcare professionals

🤝 Collaborate With a Pediatric Team

  • Work alongside Speech Therapists, Physical Therapists, physicians, and other professionals to provide coordinated care

A Therapist Who Is:

✅ Comfortable working independently in a contractor-based role
✅ Able to manage a caseload, documentation, scheduling, and family communication independently

✅ Comfortable learning and navigating telehealth technology
✅ Professional, organized, and committed to delivering high-quality care

We are looking for therapists who:

  • DoD PKI / Internal Medium Assurance (IMA)

  • Accurately assign CPT, HCPCS, ICD-10-CM, and modifiers for Outpatient and Emergency Department (ED) encounters.

Preferred Experience
