  • Analyze bids to identify key/mandatory requirements, risks, and opportunities

jobs.title: Senior Sales Development Representative
jobs.excerpt: This is a remote position. The VisionSignalmash is a CPaaS company: SMS (10DLC, Toll-Free, and Short Code), RCS, SIP trunking, VoIP PBX solutions, and voice infrastructure.
jobs.description:
This is a remote position.

The Vision

Signalmash is a CPaaS company: SMS (10DLC, Toll-Free, and Short Code), RCS, SIP trunking, VoIP PBX solutions, and voice infrastructure. We exist in the same space occupied by Twilio, Telnyx, and Bandwidth. We run an established, revenue-generating wholesale voice business with a stronghold in text messaging services for US businesses. (Preferable) Experience with voice and SMS in omnichannel communications is a strong plus, but drive matters more than background. If you're self-motivated, accountable, and eager to master new technologies alongside a collaborative team, we want to hear from you.

Our customers today come from inbound demand and from our reputation in the voice market. What we have not built yet is the outbound muscle; no validated outbound ICP, no battle-tested messaging, no internal conversion benchmarks. That is not a gap we are hiding, it is the job.

We are actively looking to hire four dedicated & experienced Sales Development Representatives (SDR’s) to build the outbound motion from first principles: figure out which ICP converts, what messaging converts leads into clients, what objections exist in the market and work as a team to determine a path forward on how to beat them, and turn all of it into a documented playbook. If you have only ever executed someone else's playbook, this role might not be for you. If you’ve always wanted to be the person who has a say on what needs to be done to create a successful playbook, you’re in the right place.

Why This Beats a Bigger Logo

  • Ownership, not headcount:At a large company you are an employee number, potentially one templated email away from a layoff. With Signalmash, you have a name, your work is visible to the entire company, and the playbook you build carries your fingerprints.

  • You will work directly with the founding team and C-Suite executives. The people taking the meetings you book are the same people you work side by side with. No layers, no politics, no waiting three levels for a decision.

  • A real leadership path:Whoever builds the playbook and proves a predictable pipeline earns the shot at heading the outbound team, hiring and building it around their own system. We expect to make that call within 6 to 12 months, decided on results, not tenure.

  • Skills that compound:This is where actual selling ability gets tested and built; cold conversations, message crafting, & market discovery – The rep who does this well becomes twice the professional they were. You will learn new skills & tactics as you grow with the company, skills that have overlap into any software-based company.

What You Will Do

  • Own the full outbound motion for your territory/ICP: account selection, contact mapping, multi-channel cadences (calls, email, LinkedIn), and booking qualified meetings for the AE team.

  • Form and test ICP hypotheses against our strongest signal, our existing customer base, and kill or scale them based on data.

  • Build the playbook as you go: messaging that gets responses, an objection taxonomy with working rebuttals, cadence structures, and internal benchmarks.

  • Run a written learning log and a weekly funnel review with the sales team. You get full transparency and support on tap; you drive your own ramp.

Hours and Work-Life Commitments

This is a US-hours role:7:00 PM to 3:00 AM IST, covering East Coast mornings through West Coast afternoons.We are specific about balance instead of vague about culture:

  • No day-shift meetings stacked on top of your night.

  • Saturdays and Sundays fully off. No weekend pipeline reviews, ever.

  • Recover, rejuvenate, and start each week fresh. We believe that burned-out reps build nothing, and it’s important to get the rest you need to excel.


Requirements

Who We Are Looking For

  • 3+ years of outbound B2B SaaS sales experience selling into the US market with average deal size of $2500+/month, with the call recordings and funnel numbers to prove it.

  • Immaculate English, spoken and written, near-native fluency. You will spend your day on the phone with US decision-makers.

  • Evidence of building, not just running: a territory you opened, messaging you wrote, a process you created that others used.

  • Experience of handling mid-market deals with multiple stakeholders.

  • Structured and self-directed. Full transparency and support, but no script handed to you, because none exists yet.

  • Comfortable with technical products, sales AI workflows or demonstrably fast at learning them.

Remote Setup Requirements

  • Dedicated quiet workspace

  • Reliable high-speed internet with a backup connection

  • Power backup solutions.

Process

Three rounds. Here is exactly what to expect:

  • Round 1 - Screening (20-25 minutes):A quick call with the hiring manager Suryansh. We talk, get a feel for each other, and listen for one thing: do you sound like someone who has actually done this job.

  • Round 2 - Skills:Suryansh & Miles go deep on your track record: your call recordings, your funnel numbers, and how you ran things in previous roles. Then we work through live scenarios on the call, so come ready to sell.

  • Round 3 - Culture:A conversation with Noah & Jeremy from the executive team. Mostly about how you work and whether we fit each other; expect a few skills questions here too.

Our teams are transparent about everything; we expect the same from anyone who joins Signalmash, for their success and the company’s.

How to Apply

Send two things

  • Your resume.

  • A 2-3 minute Loom video telling us why you want to join Signalmash and why this role is a good fit for you. The video is mandatory; applications without it will not be reviewed.


Benefits

Compensation

₹18,00,000 fixed base. On-target earnings above ₹25 lakh.(with a bridge during RAMP period)Uncapped variables with accelerators that pay more per meeting as you pass quota, plus health insurance and allowances (full CTC discussed during the process), plus we are willing to set up reasonable personal sales-tool on top of our stack.

We share the complete compensation mechanics, our real funnel numbers, and your full first-90-days plan in a candidate pack after the initial screening call.

jobs.description:
About Aalyria:

Aalyria is a leading technology company that supplies laser communications technology and temporospatial software-defined networking platforms to the aerospace industry. With technology acquired from Google, Aalyria is at the forefront of innovation in satellite and airborne mesh networks, as well as cislunar and deep-space communications. We are revolutionizing the orchestration and management of planetary mesh networks using any radio or optical spectrum, any orbit, and any hardware across land, sea, air, and space.

Role Overview:

The Aalyria Tightbeam team focuses on delivering the world’s most advanced optical communication solutions. As an electrical engineer working on the team you will develop and deliver systems for our next-generation land, sea, air & space optical communications terminals and support systems. We need our engineers to be versatile, display leadership qualities and be enthusiastic to take on new problems as we continue to push technology forward. With your technical expertise you will manage project priorities, deadlines, and deliverables. You will personally design, develop, test, deploy, maintain, and enhance electrical engineering solutions.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Collaborate with a cross-functional team on electronics integration, troubleshooting, and optimization for free-space optical (FSO) technology.
  • Assist design and development of all aspects of electronics design from individual PCBAs to higher level system integrations.
  • Use ECAD tools to design custom PCBAs including digital and mixed signal circuitry.
  • Research and select electronics components, and create and maintain CAD libraries to support PCBA design.
  • Assist in documentation of designs, test plans, and technical reports for internal teams and project stakeholders as well as customers.
  • Perform tests on the benchtop, during integration, and for experimental data collection.
  • Create wiring and cable drawings for individual assemblies as well as connection diagrams between individual PCBAs and higher level assemblies.
  • Assist as technical POC for electronics with vendors, customers, and other internal stakeholders.

Required Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering or equivalent practical experience.
  • Up to 3 years of electrical engineering experience in embedded systems for industrial applications.
  • Ability to design PCBAs using ECAD design software (KiCAD, Altium, etc).
  • Experience in all phases of designing circuits boards, including circuit design and component selection, schematic capture, PCB layout, and manufacturing.
  • Familiarity with Electrical Engineering lab fundamentals and electronic test equipment (e.g., oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, multi-meters, etc.).
  • Passion for being in the lab, problem solving, and engineering.
  • Experience with bringing up and debugging prototype PCBAs.
  • Foundational knowledge in design for manufacture and new product introduction.
  • Experience with wire/cable assembly design or wiring diagrams.
  • Understanding of designing for compliance with industry standards (FCC, UL, etc.)
  • Familiarity with board and system level power analysis.
  • Experience with specifying acceptance tests, design of experiments, data collection, and data analysis.
  • Comfortable traveling and working in a broad range of deployment environments.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • 3 - 6 years of electrical engineering experience in designing electronics for industrial,
  • aerospace, or military applications.
  • Experience with KiCAD EDA software.
  • Foundational knowledge of designing and laying out circuits with high speed digital (2.5Gbps+), analog, and mixed signal circuitry.
  • Ability to hand solder and modify circuit boards, perform board level validations, and integrate into larger assemblies.
  • Experience designing, testing, and debugging products compliant with industry EMI/EMC standards (FCC, UL, etc).
  • Experience with wire and cable design for industrial, aerospace, or military applications.
  • Familiarity with version control using Git.
  • Comfortable working with Linux (Ubuntu, embedded Linux) in the terminal.
  • Experience working with embedded C.
  • Familiarity with RF and/or optical link budgets.

About Reserv

  • Reserv is an insurtech creating and incubating cutting-edge AI and automation technology to bring efficiency and simplicity to claims. Founded by insurtech veterans with deep experience in SaaS and digital claims, Reserv is venture-backed by Bain Capital and Altai Ventures and began operations in May 2022. We are focused on automating highly manual tasks to tackle long-standing problems in claims and set a new standard for TPAs, insurance technology providers, and adjusters alike.

    We have ambitious (but attainable!) goals and need adjusters who can work in an evolving environment. If building a leading TPA and the prospect of tackling the long-standing challenges of the claims role sounds exciting, we can’t wait to meet you.

About the role

  • We are seeking highly organized and customer-focused Resolution Specialists to join our team. The successful candidate will be responsible for communicating with customers on the phone, educating and helping the customer work through their claim to the best possible outcome. This role will also be responsible for handling an inventory of claims, triaging critical claims, and delivering service to all constituents of the claim. The claims you will handle will be transportation-related.

    The ideal candidate has a willingness to work through and design process that supports the quickest claim resolution with the best outcome. In addition, they will collaborate closely with our product and engineering teams to give feedback and identify technology and process improvements.

    Resolution Specialists are:
  • Highly motivated and growth-oriented. Excited by the prospect of building a tech-driven claims org.
  • Passionate specialists who care about the customer and their experience.
  • Empathetic. Exercises empathy and patience towards everyone interacted with.
  • Sense of urgency - AT ALL TIMES. That does not mean working at all hours.
  • Creative. Finding the right exit ramp (pun intended) for the resolution of the claim that is in the client’s best interest.
  • Conflict-enjoyer. Conflict does not have to be adversarial, but it HAS to be conversational. Working toward a win/win claim resolution.
  • Curious. Wanting to know the whole story so the right decisions are made early and take action to prompt a quick resolution.
  • Anti-status quo. Not just wishing things were done differently but taking the appropriate actions to ensure it.
  • Communicative. Professional written and oral communication with all parties to a claim.
  • And did we mention a sense of humor? Claims are hard enough as it is.

What you'll do

  • Provide prompt, courteous and high-quality customer service to all policyholders and claimants by answering customer calls, filing claims, and resolving customer requests
  • Manage an inventory of litigated and non-litigated cases
  • Analyze and review auto insurance claims to identify areas of dispute, investigating and gathering all necessary information and documentation related to the claim, evaluating liability and damages related to the claim, and negotiating and settling claims with opposing parties or their insurance providers
  • Ensure compliance with specific state regulations, policy provisions, and standard operating procedures
  • Manage both non-litigation and litigation cases related to auto claims disputes, communicate with involved parties, attending mediations, arbitrations, and court hearings as necessary, and communicating regularly with clients, claims adjusters, attorneys, and other stakeholders
  • Collaborate with defense counsel, claims counsel, and litigation claims management for strategic planning, including developing and maintaining positive working relationships with approved defense firms and other vendors in the industry
  • Review legal documents and ensuring compliance with initial suit-handling plan of action
  • Serve as corporate representative for discovery review and depositions, and appearing as Corporate Representative at depositions and trials when needed
  • Analyze policy language and reaching appropriate coverage decisions, drafting frequent and complex coverage correspondence, and proactively managing non-litigated and litigated claim files from inception to closure
  • Direct and control the activities and costs of numerous outside vendors including defense counsel and coverage counsel, experts and independent adjusters
  • Maintain adjuster licenses and continuing education requirements

Requirements

  • Active insurance adjuster’s license by way of a designated home state, or home state
  • Bachelor's degree (lack of one should not stop you from applying if you possess all the other qualifications)
  • Minimum of 3 years of experience on point and concentrated in transportation claims adjusting, ideally with:
    • Third-party PD
    • Third-party bodily injury, including catastrophic losses
    • UM/UIM bodily injury
    • Litigation experience
    • PIP a plus, but not required
  • Willing to obtain all licenses within 60 days, including completing state-required testing.
  • Knowledge of state regulations, policy provisions, and standard operating procedures.
  • Willingness to travel for clients and claims need

Benefits

  • Generous health-insurance package with nationwide coverage, vision, & dental
  • 401(k) retirement plan with employer matching
  • Competitive PTO policy – we want our employees fresh, healthy, happy, and energized!
  • Generous family leave policy
  • Work from anywhere to facilitate your work-life balance
  • Apple laptop, large second monitor, and other quality-of-life equipment that might be needed. Technology is something that should make your life easier, not harder!

Additionally, we will

  • Provide a manageable pending to deliver the service in a way always wanted from a dedicated account.
  • Listen to the Resolution Specialist's feedback to enhance and improve upon the long-standing challenges.
  • Work toward reducing and eliminating all the administrative work from a Resolution Specialist.
  • Foster a culture of empathy, transparency, and empowerment in a remote-first environment.

At Reserv, we value diversity and believe that a variety of perspectives leads to innovation and success. We are actively seeking candidates who will bring unique perspectives and experiences to our team and welcome applicants from all backgrounds.

jobs.description:
POSITION TITLE:

Ghost Gear Communications Strategist

DEPARTMENT/PROGRAM:

Strategic Communications

REPORTS TO:

Vice President, Strategic Communications

STATUS:

Two-year Contract, Part-time (20 hours per week)

LOCATION:

AK, CA, DC, FL, MD, OR, TX, VA, WA, WV

ABOUT OCEAN CONSERVANCY

For more than 50 years, Ocean Conservancy has delivered effective, evidence-based solutions for the ocean and all who depend on it. Today, we continue to unite science, people and policy to protect our ocean from the greatest challenges it faces: climate change, plastic pollution and biodiversity loss. We are a 501(C)3 headquartered in Washington, D.C. that inspires a worldwide network of partners, advocates and supporters through our comprehensive and clear-eyed approach to ocean conservation. Together, we are securing a healthy ocean and a thriving planet, forever and for everyone.

POSITION SUMMARY

The Ghost Gear Communications Strategist will develop and begin implementing a communications strategy to advance Ocean Conservancy’s work on ghost gear (lost, abandoned or discarded fishing gear) which is pound for pound the deadliest form of debris to marine life.

The Strategist will seize opportunities over the next year to advance our conservation work on this critical issue, develop foundational materials and content for ghost gear communications and lay the groundwork to grow Ocean Conservancy’s public footprint on ghost gear over the next five to ten years. The Strategist will also develop a brand guide to ensure alignment between Ocean Conservancy and the Global Ghost Gear Initiative (GGGI), a global alliance convened by Ocean Conservancy that brings together industry, NGOs and governments.

The Strategist will report to the Vice President, Strategic Communications and work in close partnership with both the ghost gear program team and the strategic communications department at Ocean Conservancy.

PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Develop an understanding of the issue of ghost gear and Ocean Conservancy’s work in this area.
  • Develop foundational materials and content for ghost gear, including:
    • Core messaging on ghost gear
    • Formatted two-pager
    • Video optimized for social media
    • Evergreen social media posts/graphics
    • Carousel explainer on types of ghost gear
    • Video explainers on how ghost gear ends up in our ocean (where it travels, how it impacts animals, etc.)
    • Videos on specific locations
    • Media list / core spokespeople / media pitch
  • Develop communications/branding strategy for ghost gear, which should include:
    • Goals, key audiences, tactics
    • Plan for how we’ll use GGGI social media channels
    • Intersection with Protect Where We Play, our initiative to mobilize the sports and entertainment industry to protect our ocean
    • Opportunities we’ll capitalize on in the next two years, including the Our Ocean conference and report launches
    • Five- and ten-year ghost gear opportunities and communications framing
  • Develop brand guide for Ocean Conservancy/GGGI to ensure alignment in all comms
  • Three public communications moments executed (e.g. launch of new research)

SKILLS/QUALIFICATIONS/EXPERIENCE

  • Minimum 5 years of experience in digital or communications strategy, with a proven track record of developing and launching new communications campaigns and initiatives.
  • Proven ability to produce compelling content across formats: social, long-form, video scripts, email and campaign copy.
  • Strong writing and editing skills with the ability to adapt voice and tone across audiences and channels.
  • Proven track record of securing media coverage.
  • Nonprofit experience a plus.
  • Ability to travel occasionally.

EDUCATION/TRAINING

Bachelor’s degree in Communications or related field preferred.

COMPENSATION

Ocean Conservancy is committed to fair pay practices and posts expected salary ranges for each of its positions. Compensation will be commensurate with the candidate’s specialty skills, years of experience, location, and unique background. The expected pay range for this role is $90 to $100 hourly. We would welcome the opportunity to connect with potential candidates whose salary requirements may be outside of the expected range.

TO APPLY

If you think you’d be a great fit for the job and are interested in joining Ocean Conservancy’s team, please apply here. Please include a resume and cover letter in one file on your application.

HYBRID WORK ENVIRONMENT

Ocean Conservancy embraces a hybrid work environment, which allows our staff the flexibility to work virtually and in-person while building strong connections across the institution.

EQUAL OPPORTUNITY EMPLOYER

Ocean Conservancy provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws.

This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including recruiting, hiring, placement, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, transfer, leaves of absence, compensation, and training.

We encourage applicants who have a diverse level and range of relevant skills and experiences to apply. A 100% match is not required. We want to support employees’ career growth and in return, our employees help Ocean Conservancy grow into a stronger, more inclusive institution.

Position Summary

The Sr Principal, Family Office Practice Leader, PRM is the organization's most senior individual contributor and enterprise authority for Family Office risk management solutions within the Private Risk Management (PRM) practice. This role is responsible for shaping the strategic direction, market positioning, industry influence, and long-term growth of the Family Office practice while serving as the firm's foremost expert in advising family offices, ultra-high-net-worth (UHNW) families, family enterprises, private investment structures, trusts, foundations, and multigenerational wealth clients. Operating at the highest level of professional influence, this role serves as a trusted advisor to executive leadership and strategic clients, providing thought leadership and consultation on the most complex risk management, wealth preservation, and insurance challenges facing family office organizations. The Sr Principal partners with business leaders, producers, carrier executives, wealth advisors, legal professionals, and other centers of influence to drive innovation, establish market-leading capabilities, and influence enterprise priorities. As an pre-eminent professional, this role has broad organizational impact, influences business strategy across multiple practices, and is recognized both internally and externally as an industry authority. The Sr Principal leads through expertise, thought leadership, strategic influence, and relationship capital rather than formal organizational authority.

Primary Responsibilities

Enterprise Family Office Strategy & Practice Leadership

  • Establish and influence the long-term strategic vision, market direction, and growth strategy for the Family Office practice within the PRM organization.
  • Serve as the organization's senior authority on family office risk management, advising executive leadership on emerging trends, market opportunities, business strategy, and competitive positioning.
  • Drive the development of innovative service models, advisory capabilities, and risk management solutions designed specifically for family offices, UHNW families, and complex wealth structures.
  • Identify emerging business opportunities and market trends that impact family offices, wealth preservation strategies, and affluent client segments.
  • Influence enterprise-level strategic initiatives and business planning activities impacting the Family Office and Private Risk Management practices.

Complex Client Advisory & Thought Leadership

  • Serve as the lead advisor and escalation resource for the firm's most sophisticated family office relationships and highest-profile private client engagements.
  • Consult on highly complex personal and commercial risk structures involving family offices, trusts, private aviation, marine portfolios, luxury real estate, investment partnerships, family foundations, cybersecurity, executive protection, and global exposures.
  • Develop innovative approaches to risk management, insurance program design, and wealth preservation that support complex family enterprise objectives.
  • Act as a thought leader and recognized authority within the private risk management and family office community through speaking engagements, authorship, industry participation, and strategic advisory activities.
  • Support strategic client retention, growth, and acquisition efforts involving key family office, UHNW, and influential client relationships.

Business Development & Industry Influence

  • Develop executive-level relationships with family office executives, private bankers, wealth management firms, multifamily offices, trustees, estate attorneys, accountants, investment advisors, and other influential market participants.
  • Generate and influence high-value business opportunities through strategic networking, market engagement, and development of trusted advisor relationships.
  • Partner with producers and business leaders to pursue complex opportunities involving significant revenue potential and strategic importance.
  • Influence industry conversations, market innovation, and best practices that strengthen the firm's reputation and competitive position.
  • Represent the organization at industry conferences, advisory boards, professional associations, and executive-level market forums.

Carrier & Market Leadership

  • Maintain strategic relationships with carrier executives, specialty markets, underwriting leadership, and industry innovators.
  • Influence carrier product development, underwriting strategies, coverage innovation, and market access opportunities benefiting family office and UHNW clients.
  • Evaluate evolving carrier capabilities, emerging risk solutions, and market developments to identify opportunities for differentiation and organizational growth.
  • Serve as a strategic resource to senior leadership regarding carrier relationships, market trends, and placement strategies affecting complex family office clients.

Practice Development & Organizational Capability Building

  • Establish enterprise best practices, frameworks, methodologies, and advisory standards supporting Family Office and PRM service delivery.
  • Lead development of intellectual capital, market insights, educational resources, and technical guidance utilized across the organization.
  • Mentor senior producers, advisors, practice leaders, and specialists while advancing organizational expertise and advisory capabilities.
  • Guide enterprise initiatives focused on enhancing client experience, operational effectiveness, innovation, and market leadership.
  • Influence talent development strategies by helping define competencies, training priorities, and technical excellence standards within the Family Office practice.

Required Knowledge & Experience

  • Expert-level knowledge of family office operations, wealth preservation strategies, trust and estate structures, private wealth management, and sophisticated risk management practices.
  • Industry-leading expertise in private risk management, UHNW client advisory services, specialty insurance solutions, and complex personal risk exposures.
  • Comprehensive understanding of insurance brokerage operations, carrier markets, underwriting strategies, and wealth-related risk management programs.
  • Exceptional strategic thinking capabilities with demonstrated ability to influence business strategy, practice growth, and organizational direction.
  • Recognized authority and thought leader within the family office, private wealth, or private client insurance marketplace.
  • Demonstrated ability to influence executive stakeholders, strategic partners, industry leaders, and sophisticated clients through expertise and credibility.
  • Exceptional business development and relationship management skills focused on executive-level relationships and complex opportunity development.
  • Advanced problem-solving and consultative capabilities addressing highly complex and ambiguous business and client challenges.
  • Superior communication, presentation, and executive influence skills.
  • Ability to lead enterprise initiatives, establish industry-leading practices, and create meaningful organizational impact without direct management authority.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in business, finance, insurance, risk management, economics, or related field required.
  • Advanced degrees (MBA, JD, CFP®, or comparable graduate education) preferred.
  • 10+ years of progressive experience in private risk management, family office advisory services, insurance brokerage, wealth management, or private banking serving family office, UHNW, private wealth, or complex client segments.
  • Demonstrated experience advising family offices, multigenerational wealth families, trusts, foundations, and complex private wealth organizations.
  • Nationally recognized expertise in Family Office risk management, private client advisory services, or related specialty disciplines preferred.
  • Professional designations such as CPRIA, CPCU, CIC, CRM, CAPI, CFP®, ChFC®, AEP®, or equivalent strongly preferred.
  • Demonstrated success influencing significant business opportunities, enterprise initiatives, and strategic client relationships.
  • Exceptional leadership through influence, thought leadership, and organizational impact.

26WD99788 Sr. Applied AI/ML Developer

Position overview

As a Senior ML Developer on the team, you will be responsible for leading/contributing to the design, analysis, and delivery of data-driven solutions to significant business challenges across dedicated RAG programs of work. Your horizontal expertise in testing, evaluation and causal inference in the vertical domain of user interaction with text outputs, Information Retrieval as a theoretical discipline as the enabling tool will drive end-to-end planning, POC-building, offline and online evaluation and pushing features into the hands of users.

The Senior MLE will work to deliver ML-driven technical solutions to customer needs in our platform. Sr MLEs help in coordinating delivery as part of multi-disciplinary stakeholder teams. This role is hands-on, focusing on technical problem solving with the latest in NLP and ML technology.

Our team culture is built on collaboration, mutual support, and continuous learning. As a Senior MLE, you will provide technical guidance and expertise for the team, and with other stakeholders. We emphasize an agile, hands-on, and technical approach at all levels of the team.

As a group, we want to continuously improve our Machine Learning as well as our knowledge of trends and techniques relevant to our areas. Our team strives for excellence in the theory and practice of Machine Learning. We encourage personal development and knowledge sharing.

Responsibilities

  • Design and implement Machine Learning capabilities that improve Autodesk’s RAG platforms

  • Perform statistical and data analysis and exploration to generate datasets for model training and development

  • Collaborate with other members of the team to reach better solutions, and to position our team at the cutting edge of technology and ML practice

  • Provide technical leadership and mentorship for less-experienced members of the team to deliver key ML-powered features for our Digital Customer Platform.

  • Partner with stakeholders, to solve important business objectives across a range of problems

  • Translate business requirements and objectives into problems that can be solved with a combination of Data, Statistics, and Machine Learning

Minimum Qualifications

  • MS/M.Tech/M.Math/ or PhD in Computer Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Physics, Developer, Economics, Computational Linguistics or related fields

  • 3+ years of applicable work experience in ML

  • Hands-on experience of NLU and integrating traditional search techniques into RAG

  • Proficiency with the Python Machine Learning stack, e.g. Pandas, deep learning frameworks, traditional ML, probability calibration etc.

  • Knowledge of experimental design and analysis of results

  • Demonstrate experience with leading Machine Learning teams in deploying and improving ML features in production

  • Demonstrate experience working in cross-functional teams to deliver ML solutions in production

26WD99788 Développeur principal en IA/apprentissage automatique appliqué

Aperçu du Poste

En tant que développeur principal en apprentissage automatique au sein de l’équipe, vous serez chargé de diriger ou de contribuer à la conception, à l’analyse et à la mise en œuvre de solutions fondées sur les données afin de relever des défis d’affaires majeurs dans le cadre de programmes de travail RAG dédiés. Votre expertise horizontale en matière de tests, d’évaluation et d’inférence causale dans le domaine vertical de l’interaction des utilisateurs avec les sorties textuelles, ainsi que la recherche d’information en tant que discipline théorique et outil facilitateur, vous permettront de piloter la planification de bout en bout, la création de preuves de concept (POC), l’évaluation hors ligne et en ligne, ainsi que la mise à disposition des fonctionnalités auprès des utilisateurs.

Le spécialiste principal en apprentissage automatique (MLE) travaillera à fournir des solutions techniques basées sur l’apprentissage automatique pour répondre aux besoins des clients sur notre plateforme. Les spécialistes principaux en apprentissage automatique aident à coordonner la mise en œuvre au sein d’équipes multidisciplinaires composées de parties prenantes. Ce poste est axé sur la pratique et met l’accent sur la résolution de problèmes techniques à l’aide des dernières technologies en traitement du langage naturel (TLN) et en apprentissage automatique.

La culture de notre équipe repose sur la collaboration, le soutien mutuel et l’apprentissage continu. En tant que spécialiste principal en apprentissage automatique, vous fournirez des conseils techniques et votre expertise à l’équipe ainsi qu’aux autres parties prenantes. Nous mettons l’accent sur une approche agile, pratique et technique à tous les niveaux de l’équipe.

En tant que groupe, nous souhaitons améliorer continuellement notre apprentissage automatique ainsi que notre connaissance des tendances et des techniques pertinentes pour nos domaines. Notre équipe vise l’excellence tant dans la théorie que dans la pratique de l’apprentissage automatique. Nous encourageons le développement personnel et le partage des connaissances.

Responsabilités

  • Concevoir et mettre en œuvre des capacités d’apprentissage automatique qui améliorent les plateformes RAG d’Autodesk

  • Effectuer des analyses et des explorations statistiques et de données afin de générer des ensembles de données pour l’entraînement et le développement de modèles

  • Collaborer avec les autres membres de l’équipe pour trouver de meilleures solutions et positionner notre équipe à la fine pointe de la technologie et des pratiques en matière d’apprentissage automatique

  • Assurer le leadership technique et le mentorat auprès des membres moins expérimentés de l’équipe afin de livrer des fonctionnalités clés basées sur l’apprentissage automatique pour notre plateforme client numérique.

  • Collaborer avec les parties prenantes pour atteindre des objectifs d’affaires importants en abordant un large éventail de problèmes

  • Traduire les exigences et les objectifs d’affaires en problèmes pouvant être résolus grâce à une combinaison de données, de statistiques et d’apprentissage automatique

Qualifications Minimales

  • Maîtrise (MS/M.Tech/M.Math) ou doctorat (Ph.D.) en informatique, statistiques, mathématiques, physique, développement logiciel, économie, linguistique computationnelle ou dans des domaines connexes

  • Au moins 3 ans d’expérience professionnelle pertinente en apprentissage automatique

  • Expérience pratique de la compréhension du langage naturel (NLU) et de l’intégration de techniques de recherche traditionnelles dans le RAG

  • Maîtrise de la pile d’apprentissage automatique en Python, p. ex. Pandas, les cadres d’apprentissage profond, l’apprentissage automatique traditionnel, l’étalonnage des probabilités, etc.

  • Connaissance de la conception expérimentale et de l’analyse des résultats

  • Expérience avérée dans la direction d’équipes d’apprentissage automatique pour le déploiement et l’amélioration de fonctionnalités d’apprentissage automatique en production

  • Expérience avérée de travail au sein d’équipes interfonctionnelles pour la mise en œuvre de solutions d’apprentissage automatique en production

Come help organizations be their best, while you reach new heights with a team that has your back.

Federal Sales Leaders are at the forefront of Splunk and Cisco's business. They play a crucial role in driving growth and selling enterprise software solutions to PBST Sector Agencies and lead world-class, high-performing sales teams. We are seeking folks who have measurable experience of building and improving sales territories, building teams and have a strong management background. In this role, you will:

Summary

Implementation Consultants within Guidewire Professional Services are responsible for configuration of the system, integration development and some custom development of Guidewire’s core insurance product, InsuranceNow, to enable our customers to efficiently accomplish their business aspirations and goals. An effective technical Implementation Consultant working in the Professional Services industry requires the ability to effectively communicate with a diverse group of individuals and roles, and is someone with a strong background in software configuration/ development.

All of our technical Implementation Consultants work closely and collaborate with other consultants, Business Analysts, Project Managers, Leadership, and many other cross functional team members. The culture and nature of InsuranceNow implementation is fast paced and collaborative, sharing in our company core values of integrity, rationality and collegiality.

Candidates should have several years of proven track record in key contributions to the implementation and development of packaged enterprise software delivered to the highest quality and success.

Job Description

Experience & Qualifications:

  • Minimum 2 years of directly related technical experience in a professional services role

  • Excellent communication, interpersonal, and organizational skills

  • Solid problem-solving skills, plus the desire to solve real-world business problems for our customersAbility to assess and manage risks, and communicate appropriately

  • Prior experience in a Java/Javascript/web technology development role

  • Highly experienced working with Java environments and understanding of Java runtime and library functionality including troubleshooting tools (i.e. understanding of Heap Dumps, Memory allocation, etc in the context of running applications).

  • High competency in understanding Log configuration (Log4J), ability to efficiently read and understand log files to troubleshoot realtime or historical issues.

  • Understanding and experience with technologies such as Apache Tomcat, AWS (S3, PrivateLink, Lambda, etc) and databases such SQL Server, MySQL, AWS Aurora, etc

  • Working knowledge of web technologies such as XML, HTML, Java Script, and Apache Velocity

  • Working experience with software development tools such as Eclipse IDE, IntelliJ, source version control such as GitHub; experience with project coordination tools such as SharePoint, Smartsheet, Jira, etc.

  • Working experience and knowledge of API’s, micro services, and understanding of core system integrations to accomplish business functionality while using state of the art technologies.

  • Experienced in maintaining relationships with internal team members and partner organizations

  • Experienced with working in a cross-functional team and with team members in different geographical locations

  • Ability to demo the packaged software system, as a whole, or in functional part (user stories) that you are a contributing to the implementation

  • Knowledge of Agile software development processes

  • Ability to perform peer code reviews on all functional (user stories) to ensure quality and adherence to acceptable code standards

  • Able to coordinate multiple priorities and demonstrate initiative in starting and completing projects

  • Advanced knowledge of Amazon Web Services infrastructure and technologies are a plus

  • Previous experience working in a customer facing technical environment is a plus

  • Provided examples of working with a wide range of individuals with different skill sets is a plus

  • Property and Casualty Insurance knowledge a plus

Education Qualifications:

Overview

Role: Senior Analyst, Process Optimization Engineering Team (POET)

As a Senior Analyst, Process Optimization Engineering Team (POET) member at Qualfon, this position will work on client projects (internal or external) as part of a team and take responsibility for problem-solving.

This role will play a key management role in gathering and analyzing data, designing and building solutions for clients. The role is expected to work on varied projects across the company and with clients leading different industries. It will contribute to the client’s business strategy, aid in the execution of the proposed strategy, become an expert in the client’s organization and industry, and turn data into meaningful insights and transformative solutions.

Responsibilities

  • Identify Improvement Opportunities

    • Assist process owners in identifying improvement opportunities.
    • Contextualize and conceptualize objectives and needs within the framework of:
      • Mission Statement
      • Mission Leader role definition
      • STRIDES values

Vorstandsmitglied Finanzen und Reporting

Der Street Child Deutschland e.V. sucht eine engagierte Person mit Teamgeist als Mitglied des geschäftsführenden Vorstands mit Fokus auf Finanzen und Reporting. Street Child Deutschland ist Mitglied des seit 20 Jahren bestehenden, internationalen Street Child Netzwerkes. Street Child ist in der Entwicklungszusammenarbeit in über 20 der ärmsten und oft von Krisen betroffenen Ländern aktiv. Der Schutz und die Bildung von Kindern sowie die Sicherung des Lebensunterhaltes von Familien steht im Mittelpunkt unseres Wirkens.

Neben einer engen Zusammenarbeit mit den deutschen Vorstands- und Teamkollegen bietet dieses Ehrenamt auch die Möglichkeiten, unser europäisches Fundraising-Team in Barcelona und London zu unterstützen und mit den Vorstandsmitgliedern im globalen Street Child Netzwerk zusammenzuarbeiten.

  • Den Verein in strategischen, finanziellen und strukturellen Belangen mit verantworten und weiterentwickeln
  • Die Organisation nach innen und außen vertreten
  • Als Mitglied des dreiköpfigen geschäftsführenden Vorstands die Leitung und Geschäftsführung des Vereins in Zusammenarbeit mit dem Country Manager Deutschland verantworten
  • Verantwortung Finanzverwaltung, Jahresabschluss sowie Dokumentation der Mittelverwendung
  • Koordination und Begleitung des jährlichen Audits durch eine externe Wirtschaftsprüfung.

jobs.excerpt: REBORRN is a new breed of management consultancy, future-proofing global marketing teams for the age of change.
jobs.description:
REBORRN is a new breed of management consultancy, future-proofing global marketing teams for the age of change. Its proprietary “58” methodology tackles complex business challenges in under three days by bringing the right people together in a focused, agile, and distraction-free environment. REBORRN is a cross-functional team of 55+ experts working across geographies to drive radical transformation through design thinking and hands-on problem-solving.

Focused on fast, impact-driven solutions, REBORRN’s expertise spans every need of a modern marketing team, from Strategy & Transformation to Capability Upskilling, Team Optimisation, CX Transformation, and Experience & Innovation. Over the years, REBORRN has partnered with some of the world’s most influential brands, including The Coca-Cola Company, Philip Morris International, L’Oréal, Nestlé, Bayer, PUIG, and more.

Our team is growing quickly, and we are always looking to enrich our pool with top-tier talent for future opportunities.

Sounds fancy? It’s not. Being part of our team may not be your typical job. We are looking for makers, people who can actually get things done and see them through. And that can be messy.

Happy with that? Read on.

What’s your day-to-day

Our team is diverse in background, superpowers and perspectives. Expect to work daily alongside data scientists, product designers, marketing experts, management consultants and organisational designers. Most of your projects will require you to be part of, or lead, teams of people you have never worked with before.

We work with some of the most influential organisations in the world, including The Coca-Cola Company, L'Oreal, Bayer and Philip Morris International, on a variety of projects. While we are a newborrn consultancy with a very diverse portfolio of engagements, there is a clear pattern in how we approach problem-solving that will give you a sense of what your work at REBORRN would look like.

You will work in agile teams with coworkers and the client to make things happen, whether that means delivering a tough-to-implement action plan, launching a new product to market, or designing and deploying a new process that removes bottlenecks and increases efficiency.

Your job is done when you make yourself obsolete, and you are confident enough to fire yourself from the project.

What kind of projects? Anything from sharpening strategy and turning it into progress by rewiring how teams work and building the capabilities that matter most, to upgrading operating systems and designing consumer experiences that drive growth. It could mean landing a new product line, creating a global campaign process, or rethinking a client’s entire innovation model.

In any of the above cases, you’ll be working in a vibrant environment that’s at times intense with shifting priorities and plenty of challenges. It’s fast-paced, ever-evolving, and definitely not your comfort zone. But one thing is certain: you’ll never get bored.

Requirements

Who you are.

We do not care about your MBA, your corporate background, or your university alumni network. We are far more interested in who you are and what you can bring to the team.

You have experience working in a business role, whether in an established company, a start-up, or a consulting firm. A combination of these would certainly get our attention.

You are an excellent problem solver. You confront challenges with a results-oriented approach and a healthy mix of strategic and creative thinking.

You have a strong record of proactivity and great self-management skills. You see yourself as a highly organised multitasker who can prioritise and meet tight deadlines like a pro, all while keeping a sharp eye for detail.

You are a fast learner with a “can-do-anything” attitude. Seeking feedback comes as naturally as breathing, and you see mistakes as excellent learning opportunities. You are also great with people.

You are tech-savvy and constantly exploring how technology and new tools can make your life easier. You are curious by nature! We are flexible on remote working, so knowing how to operate independently and stay self-organised is important too.

Last but not least, you care. At REBORRN, we don’t accept the “this is not my job” mentality. If someone spills coffee on the floor, you pick up the mop and clean it.

Sounds interesting? Take a look at our benefits package below.

Benefits

Our most important perk is offering you an energy-laden workplace with some of the market’s top talent and an opportunity to thrive. Beyond that, here are some highlights:

  • Top-notch tech gear
  • Unlimited vacation policy
  • Private medical insurance
  • Flexible on remote working
  • Fast growth opportunities
  • Competitive Income Standards
  • All-you-can-read books policy
  • Public transport travel card
  • Subscription for an e-Scooter or a bike
  • Stock Options Scheme
  • Amazing office space in the heart of Athens

We are looking for a Senior Data Governance Specialist to support the execution and day-to-day delivery of data governance initiatives within a financial services organization.

This role is highly hands-on and business-facing. You will work closely with business stakeholders, data owners, and technical teams to understand the current data landscape, including existing data infrastructure, resources and products, identify gaps, and help deliver concrete governance outcomes—such as enriched data catalogs, defined ownership, and actionable data quality improvements.

This is not a purely strategic role. The ideal candidate is someone who can roll up their sleeves, actively contribute to deliverables using industry-standard tools to perform exploration, orchestration and other data management tasks, and translate conversations with the business into clear actions, documentation, and execution.

Education

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Data Management, Information Systems, Computer Science, Business Analytics, or a related field.

Professional Experience

  • 5+ years of experience in Data Governance, Data Quality, Data Management, or related roles.

  • Proven hands-on experience supporting data governance execution in regulated environments (financial services, banking, insurance, or similar).

  • Experience working directly with business stakeholders to understand data needs, challenges, and priorities.

Key Responsibilities

  • Support the execution of data management and governance initiatives across multiple business functions.

  • Work directly with business stakeholders to understand current data landscapes, challenges, and needs.

  • Capture outcomes from stakeholder meetings and translate them into clear action plans and governance deliverables.

  • Identify and prioritize high-impact, low-complexity opportunities to deliver immediate value and demonstrate the tangible benefits of data governance to stakeholders.

  • Contribute to the enrichment and maintenance of the enterprise data catalog (definitions, ownership, metadata).

  • Assist with defining, implementing, and monitoring data quality rules in collaboration with Data Quality and Engineering teams.

  • Support data lineage and metadata documentation efforts.

  • Help coordinate data governance activities across domains, ensuring follow-through and execution.

  • Document governance processes, decisions, definitions, and artifacts clearly and consistently.

  • Participate in business-facing sessions and working meetings, serving as a bridge between business and data teams.

  • Support regulatory and audit-related data governance requirements through proper documentation and controls.

Required Technical Skills

  • Strong understanding of data governance concepts, data ownership, stewardship, and metadata.

  • Hands-on experience with data catalogs and lineage tools (e.g., Collibra, Alation, Informatica EDC, Azure Purview).

  • Solid SQL skills to support data investigation, validation, and profiling.

  • Familiarity with data quality concepts and collaboration with DQ teams.

  • Understanding of ETL/ELT processes and data pipelines.

  • Experience using Jira, ServiceNow, or similar tools to track governance tasks and issues.

Soft Skills

  • Advanced English proficiency (written and verbal).

  • Strong attention to detail and documentation skills.

  • Comfortable interacting with business stakeholders and facilitating working sessions.

  • Highly organized, able to manage multiple parallel tasks and follow through on deliverables.

  • Practical, execution-oriented mindset.

Nice to Have

  • Experience with cloud data platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP).

  • Basic scripting (Python) for supporting data checks or automation

    Backcountry's online platform serves as the backbone of our customer experience, and this role exists to ensure its reliability, performance, and scalability. As Site Reliability Engineer, you will partner with software engineering, DevOps, and IT operations teams to optimize systems and applications across a multi-cloud stack.

    Within 6–12 months, you will have contributed meaningful improvements to service resiliency and observability, reduced operational toil through automation, and established yourself as a trusted partner to development and infrastructure teams.

    This is a lean team. You will own a lot, move fast, and make decisions with full end-to-end responsibility.

  • Drive resolution of critical incidents and ensure fixes are methodically implemented through postmortems
  • Leverage AI-assisted engineering tools (Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, MCP-based agents) to investigate, automate, and ship fixes across infrastructure and application repositories

  • Participate in FinOps initiatives across GCP and AWS, including capacity planning and committed-use discount strategy
  • Participate in the on-call support rotation within the SRE team

Required Qualifications

  • 3+ years of experience supporting containerized production services, preferably running Kubernetes
  • 3+ years of experience with Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, AWS CDK, Ansible, etc.)
  • 3+ years of cloud experience operating in Google Cloud Platform and/or AWS (multi-cloud stack; Azure/Entra exposure is a plus)
  • Comfortable diagnosing issues and shipping bug fixes directly to application code (not just infrastructure) to keep services reliable and stable
  • Comfortable performing deep dives across both infrastructure and application/software git repositories to trace issues end-to-end
  • Proficient with AI-assisted coding tools (e.g., Claude Code, GitHub Copilot) and MCP-based agents, used to accelerate investigation, code review, and automation
  • Strong knowledge of scripting and programming languages (Bash, Python, and TypeScript/Node.js)
  • Experience managing Linux (any major distribution) in production environments
  • Excellent understanding of internet application protocols (DHCP, DNS, HTTPS, SSH, etc.)
  • Understanding of how DevOps (CI/CD) and SRE practices (SLOs, SLIs) apply to daily work
  • Hands-on experience with observability tooling (Grafana, Prometheus, Loki, OpenSearch, or equivalents) and SLI/SLO instrumentation
  • Experience with GitOps and Kubernetes packaging (ArgoCD, Helm, Kustomize)
  • Proactively track emerging technology trends and developments, evaluating which ones are worth bringing into engineering practice
  • Bachelor's degree in computer science or similar, or equivalent experience
  • Advanced-level English communication skills, both verbal and written

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience using AI coding assistants (Claude Code, Codex, GitHub Copilot) to build fixes, write automation, and ship application and infrastructure code improvements
  • Familiarity with PCI-scoped or other regulated environments
  • Previous experience working in ecommerce environments
  • Professional certifications: GCP, CKA, or AWS

Why Join

    The people who do best here are builders. They take ownership, move fast, and want to see the direct impact of their work.

  • Cross-Functional Impact: Your work directly affects platform reliability for every customer and every team that depends on Backcountry's systems.
  • Modern Tech Stack: Work across a multi-cloud environment (GCP and AWS) with modern observability tooling, AI-assisted engineering, and GitOps workflows.
  • End-to-End Ownership: Own projects from investigation through implementation — you will ship automation, improve resiliency, and see the results in production.
  • Competitive Benefits: We offer an attractive benefits package including primarily remote work, private medical and life insurance, additional paid time off, monthly allowances and reimbursements, employee discounts, and opportunities for professional growth.

Interview Process

    1. Recruiter Screen - A 30-minute conversation with our recruiting team to align on the role, your background, and what you are looking for.
    2. Hiring Manager Interview - Conversation with the Site Reliability Manager focused on your SRE experience, approach to incident management, and team fit.
    3. Technical/Case Discussion - A deeper dive into infrastructure, observability, and problem-solving scenarios relevant to the role.
    4. Reference Checks - Conducted in parallel with the final stages where possible.
    5. Offer - We move quickly for the right candidate.

    Interview process is subject to change. Any updates will be communicated promptly and clearly.

jobs.description:
Responsibilities

100% Remote Emergency Radiologist (FL, MO, WA, CT, MA, NH, VT, ME)

Evening and Overnight Shifts, Full and Part Time options, Huge salary upside

Dartmouth Health’s Department of Radiology is seeking fully Remote Evening and Overnight Emergency Teleradiologists (FL, MO, WA, CT, MA, NH, VT, ME). This is a high-paying job with plenty of time off to travel and live life, offering a vibrant and fulfilling career, and being part of a thriving department. Fully remote Evening and Overnight Emergency Radiologists have no on-site responsibilities, though they are valued members of our department helping us cover multiple Dartmouth Health facilities located throughout New Hampshire and Vermont. Dartmouth Radiology is a leading, nationally known radiology enterprise covering all modalities and all radiology subspecialties.

Position Summary

Dartmouth Health is seeking a remote evening and nighttime radiologist to join our Emergency Radiology imaging division. Evening and overnight work consists of a standard emergency radiology case mix, comprised mostly of straight -forward x-rays, CTs, and Ultrasounds. We have limited overnight and evening MRs acquired as well. Our evening and overnight coverage is a team model, so candidates with specific strengths or weakness can often be accommodated.

We cover the Dartmouth Hitchcock Medical Center, which is a level I Trauma Center and has a Comprehensive Stroke Center, as well as imaging from other surrounding facilities. The Emergency radiology schedule is a 7-day-on, 14-days-off schedule with staggered, overlapping shifts covering the evening and overnight hours.

The Department values patient-centered care and a highly collaborative, respectful, caring, and engaging work environment. There is a strong working relationship with other Departments.

We are able to employ radiologists from Florida, Missouri, Washington state, Connecticut, Massachusetts, New Hampshire, Vermont, and Maine.

Though Dartmouth radiology is home to outstanding training programs, remote radiologists do not have direct educational responsibilities. We do welcome candidates who are interested in occasionally lecturing or other engagements with our educational mission, though participation in entirely voluntary without any core expectations built into the role. Remote radiologists do not routinely read out radiology residents, though limited resident interaction is possible. Our remote radiology team is also not expected to participate in research or other scholarly activities, though again, we welcome candidates who may have targeted interested and we aim to be supportive of candidate’s professional goals.

All remote radiologists will be full members of the Department as well as valued W-2 employees of Dartmouth Health. Remote readers are provided a Dartmouth owned reading station with a full suite of our standard PACS software.

Compensation

Remote radiologists are W-2 benefited employees who are compensated via our productivity-based Radiology Compensation plan. The plan offers a competitive guaranteed starting salary with opportunity for productivity incentives in addition to base.

All remote radiologists receive employer-provided retirement contributions, including a generous matching program, which are in addition to one’s salary. Medical malpractice is provided. There is a generous health insurance option specifically for remote employees.

Our faculty are encouraged to participate in continuing education, national societies, and professional development organizations, depending on the faculty’s interest and needs. We support these efforts with institutional funds allocated to each faculty member.

Schedule

The Emergency radiology schedule is a 7-day-on, 14-days-off schedule with staggered, overlapping shifts covering the evening and overnight hours. We have opportunities to do additional hours or add-on shifts (analogous to internal moonlighting) for those seeking additional income. A full-time position involves completing 4 weeks of work every 12 weeks (one week out of every three), and we have options for individuals to do part time roles (including completing 3 or 2 weeks of work every 12 weeks).

Clinical Excellence

The Department prides itself on high-quality, efficient, modern imaging and very much prizes our clinical service and the care provided to our patients. Remote readers will have an essential role in contributing to our core clinical mission. As the Vice President of Commercial Strategies and Initiatives, you will play a pivotal leadership role in shaping the future of value-based care. You will also build productive relationships with health plan channel partner account teams to generate pipeline and expand Included Health’s reach through existing channel partner contracts.

This role is responsible for both new logo growth and expansion within existing public sector and labor clients.

Key Responsibilities

  • Territory Growth Leadership: Own and expand the public sector and labor territory by developing and executing a regional go-to-market strategy focused on high-priority public entities, labor organizations, and multi-employer groups.

  • Strategic Account Development: Build and manage executive-level relationships with benefits leaders, trustees, union leadership, procurement stakeholders, and other decision-makers to position Included Health as a trusted strategic partner.

  • Complex Enterprise Sales Management: Lead complex, multi-threaded sales cycles involving internal and external stakeholders, including consultants, channel partners, finance, procurement, and executive leadership, to drive consensus and close strategic long-term contracts.

  • Regional Consultant Engagement: Develop and maintain strong relationships with consultants, brokers, TPAs, carriers, and health plan partners that influence public sector and labor purchasing decisions and strengthen Included Health’s market position.

  • Client Expansion: Identify and pursue opportunities to expand Included Health’s service portfolio within existing clients, driving additional revenue and deeper customer partnerships.

  • Sales Process Optimization: Contribute to continuous improvement of sales frameworks, tools, and playbooks that shorten the sales cycle and improve effectiveness in complex deal environments, including RFP-driven opportunities.

  • Operational Excellence: Maintain disciplined CRM documentation, pipeline management, and forecast accuracy to ensure transparency and accountability across all stages of the sales process.

  • Brand Representation:Serve as a regional ambassador for Included Health’s mission and culture in all external interactions and at relevant industry events and conferences.

  • Travel: Travel as needed to meet with prospects, clients, consultants, partners, and industry stakeholders across the territory.

During your first 30 days, you will:

  • Partner with the Division VP to come up to speed quickly on market dynamics, priority prospects, and open opportunities within the territory.

  • Complete onboarding, GTM training, and internal learning to quickly develop a strong understanding of Included Health’s products, offerings, and value proposition.

  • Begin developing your Year 1 territory and sales plan.

  • Tap into your network of buyers, influencers, and partners to identify meaningful sales opportunities.

  • Ride along with other sales leaders on client calls for learning and market immersion.

During your first 60 days, you will:

  • Establish your territory strategy and prioritize target public sector, labor, and multi-employer organizations.

  • Develop account plans and outreach strategies for high-priority prospects, including stakeholder mapping, competitive research, and clear win themes.

  • Make introductions to your network and future customers regarding Included Health.

  • Secure meetings with target organizations and conduct joint discovery and product overview meetings with senior sales leaders and cross-functional partners.

During your first 90 days, you will:

  • Independently lead discovery and product overview meetings with prospective clients and confidently articulate the value of Included Health’s solutions.

  • Engage internal subject matter experts and executive leaders to shape deal strategy, stakeholder management, and product positioning for high-priority opportunities.

  • Deepen relationships through in-person meetings, conferences, and field engagement across your market.

  • Build momentum across both new logo pursuits and expansion opportunities within existing accounts.

Qualifications

  • 7+ years of sales experience, with significant experience in selling to public sector & labor buyers in the healthcare benefits, wellness, or adjacent complex solution sales environments.

  • Proven success managing and closing long, complex sales cycles involving multiple internal and external stakeholders.

  • Strong track record of consistently meeting or exceeding large annual or multimillion-dollar quotas.

  • Deep understanding of the healthcare benefits landscape and its evolution, particularly as it relates to public sector and labor purchasers.

  • Demonstrated consultative selling skills, including uncovering client pain points, quantifying business impact, and aligning solutions to strategic benefits and cost-management goals.

  • Established credibility and relationship-building ability with consultants, brokers, TPAs, carriers, clients, and other influencers in the public sector and labor ecosystem.

  • Exceptional executive communication, negotiation, and storytelling skills with senior stakeholders and decision-makers.

  • Strong references from clients, partners, and influencers you have worked with in the past.

  • Proficiency with Salesforce or similar CRM systems, with disciplined pipeline and forecast management.

  • Willingness to travel domestically as needed to fulfill job responsibilities

The base salary range for this full-time position is $170,000 – $210,000 per year in the United States. This posted range reflects the portion of our internal salary band that is currently funded for new hires in this role across our standard labor markets (Zones A–C).

Our outcomes meaningfully outperform traditional care for autistic adults, with substantially greater improvements in mood, anxiety, and quality of life.

jobs.excerpt: Summary We are seeking a highly skilled, hands-on Medical Bill Review (Working) Supervisor to lead our day-to-day bill review operations while actively participating in complex case reviews and serving as a key resource for our legal services division.
jobs.description:
Summary

We are seeking a highly skilled, hands-on Medical Bill Review (Working) Supervisor to lead our day-to-day bill review operations while actively participating in complex case reviews and serving as a key resource for our legal services division. In this dual-capacity role, you will manage a small team of bill reviewers and maintain a production workload focused on high-dollar, complex medical bill review/legal cases. You will leverage an intimate knowledge of major medical bill review software and national repricing/payer systems, ensuring absolute accuracy in identifying excessive or unsupported charges, determining reasonable reimbursement amounts, and defending those findings in litigation. Crucially, you will serve as a Subject Matter Expert (SME) and Expert Witness for legal proceedings, providing forensic billing analyses, affidavits, and deposition/trial testimony. This is a national role; however, Texas-specific expertise is preferred in billing regulations, workers' compensation guidelines, and Usual, Customary for other states, and Reasonable (UCR) fee structures.

Requirements

Primary Responsibilities

Operations & Production Leadership (Working Supervisor)

  • Team Management: Supervise, mentor, and audit the performance of expert bill review

staff and contract experts to ensure accuracy, productivity, and adherence to turnaround

times.

  • Hands-on Review: Function as a "working" supervisor by directly reviewing complex,

high-dollar, or disputed medical bills (e.g., trauma, inpatient stays, etc).

  • Quality Assurance: Conduct regular quality control audits on team output, identifying

training gaps and updating standard operating procedures (SOPs).

Software & Payer System Repricing Optimization

  • System Mastery: Act as the internal administrator/expert for our Medical Bill Review

software, optimizing workflows, auto-adjudication rules, and engine logic specific to

Dane Street and Client preferences and requirements.

  • National Repricing/Payer Systems: Apply comprehensive knowledge of national

repricing mechanisms and payer guidelines to maximize accuracy and identify

erroneous billing/overbilling.

  • Reimbursement Integrity: Ensure correct application of fee schedules, line-item audits,

CCI edits, and clinical validation rules across commercial, auto/PIP, and workers'

compensation lines.

Legal Services & Expert Witness Support

  • Forensic Auditing: Conduct comprehensive forensic reviews of medical records, itemized

bills, and payment ledgers for cases entering litigation.

  • Expert Reports & Affidavits: Author legally defensible, clear, and well-supported expert

reports outlining billing accuracy, unbundling, upcoding, or phantom charges.

  • Testimony: Provide credible, articulate deposition and trial testimony as a designated

expert witness, translating complex coding systems (CPT, ICD-10, HCPCS, DRG) into

plain language for attorneys, judges, and juries.

  • (PREFERRED) Texas Regulatory Alignment: Demonstrate masterful application of

Texas-specific codes (e.g., Texas Labor Code for Workers' Comp, Texas Civil Practice

and Remedies Code Section 18.001 affidavits, and TDI regulations).

Required Qualifications & Experience

● Experience:

○ Minimum of 5–7 years of extensive, hands-on experience in Medical Bill Review

○ 2+ years of experience in a supervisory, team-lead, or senior mentoring capacity.

○ Proven, documented experience providing legal services, expert witness reports,

or trial testimony regarding medical bill reasonableness and UCR value analysis.

  • Technical Expertise: Advanced proficiency in major industry-standard bill review

platforms (e.g., Conduent/StrataCare, Mitchell/Enlyte, Medata, CompIQ or similar)

  • Based in Texas (highly preferred) or possessing extensive experience testifying

specifically within the Texas court system and applying Texas statutory fee schedules.

  • Certifications: Active industry certification is strictly required (e.g., CPC, CCS)

Key Competencies

  • The ability to spot subtle patterns of healthcare fraud, waste, and abuse or systemic

billing irregularities.

  • Poised, articulate communication style. Highly professional under examination/expert

testimony pressure.

  • Strong time-management skills to effortlessly pivot between managing a team, clearing

daily production queues, and meeting deadlines.

Benefits

Join our team at Dane Street and enjoy a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your well-being and peace of mind. We offer a range of benefits including medical, dental, and vision coverage for you and your family. Additionally, we offer voluntary life insurance options for you, your spouse, and your children. We also offer other voluntary benefits which include hospital indemnity, critical illness, accident indemnity, and pet insurance plans. Employees receive basic life insurance, short-term disability, and long-term disability coverage at no cost. Our generous paid time off policy ensures you have time to relax and recharge, while our 401k plan with a company match helps you plan for your future. Apple equipment and a media stipend are provided for remote workspace.

ABOUT DANE STREET:

A fast-paced, Inc. 500 Company with a high-performance culture, is seeking insightful forward-thinking professionals. We process over 200,000 insurance claims annually for leading national and regional Workers’ Compensation, Disability, Auto, and Group Health Carriers, Third-Party Administrators, Managed Care Organizations, Employers, and Pharmacy Benefit Managers. We provide customized Independent Medical Exams and Peer Review programs that assist our clients in reaching the appropriate medical determination as part of the claims management process.

  • Strong executive communication and consensus-building skills

At CompassX, you won’t just follow a path - you’ll create one.

Overview

Our State Government Practice Group (SGPG) is seeking an experienced IT Strategy and Operations Consultant to lead and support technology assessment, planning, modernization, and implementation support initiatives for our government clients. This role will help clients evaluate current-state IT environments, identify operational and technical improvement opportunities, develop practical future-state recommendations, and translate recommendations into actionable roadmaps. The ideal candidate will bring experience across IT strategy, IT operations, business process improvement, technology governance, enterprise systems, and client-facing consulting delivery. You will immediately assist the government of Guam and future state government clients by:

  • Assessing current-state IT operations, governance structures, service delivery models, business processes, applications, infrastructure, and staffing approaches to identify strengths, gaps, risks, and improvement opportunities.
  • Developing practical IT strategic plans, operating model recommendations, future-state concepts, and multi-year implementation roadmaps that help clients close maturity gaps and improve service delivery.
  • Conducting IT management, infrastructure, application, data, governance, and process assessments and providing detailed recommendations for improvement, including implementation plans and roadmaps.
  • Assessing underlying systems, infrastructure, and data networking environments to identify modernization needs for related hardware, software, connectivity, security, resilience, and scalability.
  • Conducting business process mapping and analysis to identify opportunities for process improvement, automation, and alignment with technology solutions.
  • Collaborating with business and IT leaders to help ensure technology investments support enterprise goals and deliver measurable value.
  • Facilitating workshops, interviews, governance discussions, and decision-making sessions with technical and business stakeholders to build shared understanding and support practical implementation.
  • Managing technology planning, selection, implementation support, and operational improvement projects to help clients align decisions with business needs, governance expectations, and technical requirements.
  • Supporting modernization planning for enterprise platforms, cloud services, data environments, and core business systems, including integration, scalability, security, and organizational readiness considerations.

You should have experience leading technical and operational workstreams for large-scale government technology initiatives, including assessment, planning, roadmap development, and implementation support. You will bring a mix of exceptional organizational and self-management qualities, strong leadership capabilities, effective written and verbal communication skills, and a willingness to travel.

The candidate filling this position can be located remotely, anywhere in the United States, or can be located in any one of our physical offices.

Travel Expectations: The candidate filling this position must be able to work within Guam Chamorro Standard Time

  • Develop project deliverables for clients.
